programme.desc: Summaries, reviews and highlights of the gala from Vienna, Austria will be shown. / Gezeigt werden Zusammenfassungen, Ruckblicke und Highlights der Gala aus Wien, Österreich.

programme.title: Herbert Prohaska: The ball, a life / Herbert Prohaska: Der Ball, ein Leben
programme.desc: Herbert Prohaska worked his way from Simmering to become Austria's footballer of the century. On the occasion of his 70th birthday, the documentary traces his unique career. There are companions like Toni Polster and Hans Krankl. / Herbert Prohaska arbeitete sich aus Simmering zum JahrhundertfuSSballer Österreichs. Anlasslich seines 70. Geburtstages zeichnet die Dokumentation seine einzigartige Karriere nach. Mit dabei sind Weggefahrten wie Toni Polster oder Hans Krankl.

programme.title: concerns: us - reports without filters / betrifft: uns - Reportagen ohne Filter
programme.sub-title: Deutschlernen - Warum dauert das so lange?
programme.desc: Discussions about deportations are always polarizing in Austria: they are often triggered by reports about immigrants who have committed criminal offenses or reports about families who have been living in Austria for a long time but have not received asylum. / Diskussionen uber Abschiebungen polarisieren in Österreich immer wieder: Ausloser sind oft Berichte uber Zugewanderte, die straffallig geworden sind, oder auch Berichte uber Familien, die schon lange in Österreich leben, aber kein Asyl bekommen.

programme.title: 9-1-1 Emergency Call L.A. / 9-1-1 Notruf L.A.
programme.desc: The series follows police officers, paramedics and firefighters in their everyday work. programme.title: Soko Linz / SOKO Linz
programme.desc: The Austrian-German team from SOKO Linz investigates exciting murder cases together. / Das osterreichisch-deutsche Team der SOKO Linz ermittelt zusammen spannende Mordfalle.

programme.title: SOKO Kitzbuhel / SOKO Kitzbuhel
programme.desc: The Tyrolean lowland with its outstanding sporting and tourist offerings is the setting for the police team led by detective Karin Kofler and her colleague Lukas Roither, who specializes in criminal psychology, and who use a lot of expertise and empathy to put a stop to the local criminals. The investigators are supported by Karin's father Hannes, who runs the legendary "Pochlarner Stuben" inn and is blessed with a similar criminal instinct as his daughter. And finally there is Countess Schonberg, who, with her contacts with the Kitzbühel jet set, repeatedly proves to be a valuable help to the officials. / Das Tiroler Unterland mit seinen herausragenden sportlichen und touristischen Angeboten ist der Schauplatz des Polizeiteams um Kriminalbeamtin Karin Kofler und ihrem auf Kriminalpsychologie spezialisierten Kollegen Lukas Roither, die mit viel Sachverstand und Einfuhlungsvermogen den ortlichen Verbrechern das Handwerk legen. Dabei werden die Ermittler von Karins Vater Hannes unterstutzt, der das legendare Gasthaus "Pochlarner Stuben" betreibt, und mit ahnlichem kriminalistischen Spursinn gesegnet ist wie seine Tochter. Und schlieSSlich ist da noch Grafin Schonberg, die sich mit ihren Kontakten zum Kitzbuheler Jetset immer wieder als wertvolle Hilfe fur die Beamten erweist.

programme.title: Claws / Claws
programme.desc: Five women own their own nail salons in Florida. But the five nail carers want more variety in their lives. For this reason, they enter the male-dominated world of organized crime. / Funf Frauen besitzen ihre eigenen Nagelstudios in Florida. Doch die funf Nagelpflegerinnen wollen mehr Abwechslung in ihrem Leben. Aus diesem Grund steigen sie in die von Mannern dominierten Welt des organisierten Verbrechens ein.

programme.title: Scrubs - The Beginners / Scrubs - Die Anfanger
programme.desc: From the perspective of the young doctor J.D. The chaotic and bizarre everyday hospital life at Sacred Heart Hospital is told. Together with his friends Turk, Elliot and Carla, he overcomes all the challenges of an aspiring doctor. / Aus der Perspektive des Jungmediziners J.D. wird der chaotische und bizarre Krankenhausalltag aus dem Sacred Heart Hospital erzahlt. Gemeinsam mit seinen Freunden Turk, Elliot und Carla meistert er alle Herausforderungen eines angehenden Arztes.

programme.title: ZIB Zack Mini / ZIB Zack Mini
programme.desc: The program conveys connections and backgrounds for six to ten year olds every day. / Die Sendung vermittelt taglich Zusammenhange und Hintergrunde fur Sechs- bis Zehnjahrige.

programme.title: Nils Holgersson / Nils Holgersson
programme.desc: Fourteen-year-old Nils Holgersson annoys the animals on his parents' farm and also has other nasty fun. As a punishment, a gnome turns him into a dwarf, and the innocent hamster Krumel is not spared either. / Der vierzehnjahrige Nils Holgersson argert die Tiere auf dem elterlichen Bauernhof und treibt auch sonst uble SpaSSe. Ein Wichtelmannchen verwandelt ihn zur Strafe in einen Zwerg, und auch der unschuldige Hamster Krumel bleibt nicht verschont.

programme.title: The hunt for the Kju Wang / Die Jagd nach dem Kju Wang
programme.desc: The city of Venice, inhabited by birds, is ruled by a powerful duke. This duke owns a valuable gemstone, the Kju-Wang, which symbolizes his power. The ambassador of a foreign country wants to steal the Kju-Wang. / Die Stadt Venedig, die von Vogeln bewohnt wird, wird von einem machtigen Herzog regiert. Dieser Herzog besitzt einen wertvollen Edelstein den Kju-Wang, der seine Macht symbolisiert. Der Botschafter eines fremden Landes will den Kju-Wang stehlen.

programme.title: Hello Kasperl / Servus Kasperl
programme.sub-title: Kasperl and Pezi: Pezi and Kaspunzel
programme.desc: The show presents painting competitions, birthday greetings and stories with Punch and Judy. / Die Sendung prasentiert Malwettbewerbe, GeburtstagsgruSSe und Geschichten mit dem Kasperl.

programme.title: The miracle YOU / Das Wunder DU
programme.desc: The children's program deals with scientific topics relating to the human body. / Die Kindersendung befasst sich mit wissenschaftlichen Themen rund um den menschlichen Korper.

programme.title: Great animals / Tolle Tiere
programme.desc: Kurt the cat goes on a journey through the Schonbrunn Zoo. It introduces native and exotic wild animals as well as popular and unusual pets. As zoo helpers, two children also experience working with the zoo animals up close. / Kater Kurt begibt sich auf eine Reise durch den Tiergarten Schonbrunn. Er stellt heimische und exotische Wildtiere sowie beliebte und ungewohnliche Haustiere vor. Als Zoohelfer erleben zwei Kinder zudem hautnah die Arbeit mit den Zootieren.

programme.title: Garfield / Garfield
programme.desc: Garfield, the world's laziest cat, is back and has more fun adventures. Garfield's quirky misadventures here are generally rougher and more bizarre than in the past. / Garfield, der faulste Kater der Welt ist zuruck und erlebt noch mehr witzige Abenteuer. Dabei fallen Garfields schrullige Missgeschicke hier in der Regel derber und bizarrer aus als in der Vergangenheit.

programme.title: ZIB Zack Mini / ZIB Zack Mini
programme.desc: The program conveys connections and backgrounds for six to ten year olds every day. / Die Sendung vermittelt taglich Zusammenhange und Hintergrunde fur Sechs- bis Zehnjahrige.

programme.title: Malcolm in the middle / Malcolm mittendrin
programme.desc: A gifted child has to deal with his eccentric family. The Cleavers are a middle-class American family with a chaotic everyday life. Little Malcom uses his intelligence to plan pranks with his brothers. / Ein hochbegabtes Kind muss mit seiner exzentrischen Familie umgehen. Die Cleavers sind eine mittelstandische US-Familie mit chaotischem Alltagsleben. Der kleine Malcom nutzt seine Intelligenz, um mit seinen Brudern Streiche auszuhecken.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn Kiesewetter left the police service to run a farm. But when a fire destroys the farm, the burned-out ex-investigator returns to Lubeck and the police force. From now on he investigates here with Inspector Lars Englen. / Finn Kiesewetter hat den Polizeidienst verlassen, um einen Bauernhof zu fuhren. Doch als ein Brand den Hof zerstort, kehrt der abgebrannte Ex-Ermittler nach Lubeck und in den Polizeidienst zuruck. Fortan ermittelt er hier mit Kommissar Lars Englen.

programme.title: Smart10 - The quiz with the ten possibilities / Smart10 - Das Quiz mit den zehn Moglichkeiten
programme.desc: Two teams of two compete against each other in the knowledge duel hosted by Caroline Athanasiadis. The participants have to demonstrate general knowledge, good teamwork, tactics and risk assessment in order to be successful. / Zwei Zweierteams treten im Wissensduell bei Caroline Athanasiadis gegeneinander an. Dabei mussen die Teilnehmer Allgemeinwissen, gutes Teamwork, Taktik und Risikoeinschatzung unter Beweis stellen, um erfolgreich abzuschneiden.

programme.title: Q1 One note is incorrect / Q1 Ein Hinweis ist falsch
programme.desc: This quiz is all about clues. First, the topic of the searched term is announced. The candidates are supposed to get on the right track with the help of four clues - but only three of them are correct. / Bei diesem Quiz dreht sich alles um Hinweise. Zuerst wird das Thema des gesuchten Begriffes bekannt gegeben. Mithilfe von vier Hinweisen sollen die Kandidaten auf die richtige Spur kommen - doch nur drei davon sind richtig.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the “Jager”. This is not an easy task, because the “Jagers” are proven quiz professionals from the German national quiz team, including the German quiz master. In the first round, the candidates individually build up a game total, which they have to defend together against the “Jager” in the second round in order to advance to the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the “Jager” and defend the money they have earned so far. You must answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions correctly than the “Jager”, they win. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: Death in Paradise / Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A gruesome violent crime occurs on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. To clear it up, London investigator Richard Poole is assigned to the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but he can't get used to the Caribbean mentality at all. This always creates entertaining situations. The meticulous suit wearer manages to solve the case together with his colleagues on site. They really want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like seafood. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.title: Monk / Monk
programme.desc: The detective Adrian Monk quickly became a minor celebrity due to his special skills in his job. He has a photographic memory and can create a trail from even the smallest clues. However, since the death of his beloved wife Trudy in a mysterious attack, he has suffered from severe anxiety and obsessive-compulsive disorder, which led to his suspension from duty with the San Francisco Police Department. After locking himself in his apartment for three years, he finally sets up his own business as a private detective and is repeatedly asked by the police for support. With the help of his former boss Captain Leland Stottlemeyer and his personal assistant Sharona Fleming, Monk has since solved the crime that no one else can solve. / Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: SOKO Donau / SOKO Donau
programme.desc: The dedicated special commission of the Vienna Water Police investigates crimes in the greater area of ​​the Austrian capital. The criminal team's focus is on crimes that occur on and on the Danube and its tributaries. / Die engagierte Sonderkommission der Wiener Wasserschutzpolizei klart im GroSSraum der osterreichischen Hauptstadt Verbrechen auf. Der Fokus des Kriminalistenteams liegt dabei auf Straftaten, die an und auf der Donau sowie ihren Nebenflussen geschehen.

programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all this in the living room at home - the “Yoga Magazine” makes it possible. Competent and friendly yoga trainers show the best exercises for switching off. By the way, the program doesn't just report from the television studio. The programs are often recorded in a very special location - for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: “We move Austria” school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: The fun of sport and exercise is the main focus at WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH School. The aim of the ORF initiative is to reach students and teachers digitally with short exercise units and to have these take place every day in Austrian classrooms. Neither a gym nor sports clothing or special equipment are necessary. As an uncomplicated, daily exercise program for the classroom, WE BEWEGEN AUSTRIA wants to inspire schools to get more exercise and a healthy and balanced lifestyle. At the start of the expansion of the WE MOVE AUSTRIA initiative to the school sector, 30 episodes, each lasting six to eight minutes, with tailor-made exercises for everyday school life in the classroom are available. The focus is on strength, skill, coordination and relaxation in order to be able to better cope with the often stressful school day. The movement units are presented by qualified sports teacher Karin Augeneder. / Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Eishockey: Champions Hockey League / Eishockey: Champions Hockey League
programme.desc: The KAC around team captain Thomas Hundertpfund meets the blatant outsiders: The Polish champions have lost all four games and are in last place in the table with zero points. A win today seems to be a must for the “Red Jackets”. So far, the Klagenfurt team have won two games: They won the encounter with the Eisbaren Berlin 3-2 and beat the Odense Bulldogs 6-3. However, the KAC lost the other two games: against Sparta Prague there was a 1:2 and the duel against Brynas IF ended with a 2:4. 5th round: KAC - GKS Tychy / Der KAC um den Mannschaftskapitan Thomas Hundertpfund trifft auf die krassen AuSSenseiter: Die polnischen Meister haben alle vier Spiele verloren und stehen mit null Punkten auf dem letzten Tabellenplatz. Fur die "Rotjacken" scheint ein Sieg heute Pflicht zu sein. Bisher haben die Klagenfurter zwei Partien fur sich entschieden: Sie haben die Begegnung mit den Eisbaren Berlin mit 3:2 gewonnen und die Odense Bulldogs haben sie mit 6:3 geschlagen. Die anderen beiden Spiele hat der KAC allerdings verloren: Gegen Sparta Prag gab es ein 1:2 und das Duell gegen den Brynas IF endete mit einem 2:4. 5. Runde: KAC - GKS Tychy

programme.title: Golden boy / Zlatni dečko
programme.desc: The "Golden Boy" series follows Denis Markovic football player, who receives a termination of the contract due to problematic behavior. He has to go to Belgrade and find a new club. / Serija "Zlatni dečko" prati fudbalera Denisa Markovića, koji zbog problematičnog ponašanja dobije prekid ugovora. Mora da ode u Beograd i pronađe novi klub.

programme.title: Aloa face the forehead / Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies in the 1980s, located in the World War II in France occupied by German troops. In the town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Cafe Artois, a place to socialize French, and the Germans. Colonel von Strohm asks Renea to hide in his cafe stolen the image, which he wanted himself at the same time as Hitler. Rene is trying to maintain a balance in his business to satisfy French resistance and the Nazi troops and so he could survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: Wild bees / Divlje pčele
programme.desc: The three sisters were left alone after the death of the father. Without the support of a man, they will have to counteract the opposite and dominant sex and show that they are capable of running their own property. / Tri sestre ostale su same nakon smrti oca. Bez podrške nekog muškarca one će morati da se suprotstave suprotnom i dominantnom spolu i pokazati da su sposobne same voditi svoje imanje.

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.desc: Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. programme.title: Borilački sport - MMA / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. programme.title: MMA UFC Fight Night / MMA UFC Fight Night
programme.desc: Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. programme.title: Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. programme.title: Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. programme.title: Košarka - Turska liga / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. programme.title: Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The aim of this league to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the final tournament of the best four or popularly called Final for. The finish is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Basketball - 2. ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: 2. The ABA league is the second degree of the regional basketball ABA league. Krka New place is the historical first winner of the ABA 2. Leagues, competitions founded in the 2017/2018 season. With a victory on the Fajnal Forum and a goblet intended for the winner, the Krka team achieved a placement in 1. ABA league from the next season. The league participates 12 teams that seek the road to four best teams and placement on Fainal for. Purpose of the ABA 2. The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The aim of this league to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the final tournament of the best four or popularly called Final for. The finish is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Wing / Krah
programme.desc: Police and social service jointly investigate the Carrisford family. Ed is shocked when she finds out what Betsey really is. There are doubts about Ed's and Jessa's relationship. Liz is struggling because of his decision, and Jess cannot reconcile with social service measures. That's why time and their friends and officers speculate on what really happened. We also see when a discord arose among friends: last summer during rest in Provence. The reason was a debate on drinks, parenting and appropriate behavior. After Ed revealing that Jess is pregnant, a new fierce discussion develops. In the villa they discover various secrets and form alliances. Charlotte and Ed are connected during the moment of vulnerability, Mel is embarrassed by slave behavior, and Jess has too much protects her children. But after Liza's intoxication escalates and two children disappear, everything overwhelms panic, and the charges fly on all sides. Jess and Liz are fiercely quarreling. We are looking into the present: Liz fails to slow down the work of the social service that the family is prescribed by a new, drastic measure. / Policija i socijalna služba zajednički istražuju obitelj Carrisford. Ed se šokira kada sazna u kakvu je Betsey zapravo stanju. Javljaju se sumnje u Edov i Jessin odnos. Liz se muči zbog svoje odluke, a Jess se ne može pomiriti s mjerama socijalne službe. Zato vrijeme i njihovi prijatelji i službenici nagađaju o tome što se zaista dogodilo. Vidimo i kada se među prijateljicama javio razdor: prošloga ljeta za vrijeme odmora u Provansi. Povod je bila rasprava o piću, roditeljstvu i primjerenom ponašanju. Nakon što Ed otkrije da je Jess trudna, razvije se nova žestoka rasprava. U vili otkrivaju razne tajne i formiraju savezništva. Charlotte i Ed povežu se tijekom trenutka ranjivosti, Mel je neugodno zbog Robova ponašanja, a Jess previše štiti svoju djecu. No nakon što Lizino opijanje eskalira, a dvoje djece nestane, sve obuzme panika, a optužbe lete na sve strane. Jess i Liz žestoko se posvađaju.Vraćamo se u sadašnjost: Liz ne uspijeva usporiti rad socijalne službe koja obiteljiCarrisford propisuje novu, drastičnu mjeru.

programme.title: Culture news / Vijesti iz kulture

programme.title: A masterpiece or evil / Remek-djelo ili zlodjelo
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce and Philip Mould go to North London to meet Glyna Hopkina, a dealer with special affinities towards art. Glyn decided to risk buying a picture that hopes to be the work of one of the most important painters 18. century _ Sir Joshue Reynolds. The irresistible portrait of the boy bought impulsively on an online auction in Monaco. Although the ad is stated that "in the style of Sir Joshue Reynolds", Glyn decided to try his happiness and paid him 2700 pounds. If it is shown that it is authentic, it could be worth up to £ 100,000. The first traces act promising. Reynolds was known for experimenting with materials, which would often lead to their decay over time. Should the signs of decaying in Glyn's picture be evidence of Reynolds's recognizable technique? / Fiona Bruce i Philip Mould odlaze u sjeverni London kako bi upoznali Glyna Hopkina, trgovca automobilima s posebnim afinitetom prema umjetnosti. Glyn je odlučio riskirati kupivši sliku za koju se nada da je djelo jednog od najvažnijih slikara 18. stoljeća _ sir Joshue Reynoldsa. Neodoljivi portret dječaka kupio je impulzivno na internetskoj aukciji u Monaku. Iako je u oglasu navedeno da je "u stilu sir Joshue Reynoldsa", Glyn je odlučio okušati sreću i platio ga 2700 funti. Ako se pokaže da je autentičan, mogao bi vrijediti i do 100.000 funti. Prvi tragovi djeluju obećavajuće. Reynolds je bio poznat po eksperimentiranju s materijalima, što bi s vremenom često dovelo do njihova propadanja. Bi li znaci propadanja na Glynovoj slici mogli biti dokaz Reynoldsove prepoznatljive tehnike?

programme.title: Unit 414: witnesses and victims on October 7 / Postrojba 414: Svjedokinje i žrtve 7. listopada
programme.desc: The documentary brings a unique view of the events of October 7, 2023, from the perspective of women who were on the front line at that moment. There were 23. They were called "the eyes of the state." It is a unit 414 from Nahal Oz military base. They warned, but the state did not listen to them. They saw what was preparing and were among the first victims. Today, guards guarding the border with Gaza require the truth to be told and give us the cross -section of today's Israeli society. If they had listened to them, the attack on October 7 could be prevented. Listening to their story, we are talking about the attack, of the training of Hamas's attackers to which they testified, the failures of the Israeli secret service and the Government, the fate of hostages, and the present lines of tension in Israeli society, especially the role of women in the military. / Dokumentarni film donosi jedinstven pogled na događaje od 7. listopada 2023., iz perspektive žena koje su u tom trenutku bile na prvoj crti. Bilo ih je 23. Zvali su ih "očima države". Riječ je o jedinici 414 iz vojne baze Nahal Oz. One su upozoravale, ali država ih nije slušala. Vidjele su što se sprema i bile su među prvim žrtvama. programme.desc: The Bettany's trip starts in one of the most tallest cities of the subcontinent _ Varanasia. He goes to the boat to the Lake Palace, an extraordinary royal residence located on the island in the shining Lake Pichola. The legendary treasure and monument of love, Taj Mahal, was built in 1632. As a tomb for a favorite woman of the Mogulski Emperor Shah Restrained, Mumtaz Mahal. Fatehpur Sikri zamišljen je kao carska prijestolnica mogulskog cara Akbara. Njegov novi grad bio je veći od Londona, no bio je naseljen samo 14 godina. Zadivljujuća palača ukrašena je masivnim mramornim pločama s umetnutim rubinima, oniksom, žadom i karneolom _ koji su navodno poslužili kao inspiracija za ukrase unutar Taj Mahala. Legendarno blago i spomenik ljubavi, Taj Mahal, izgrađen je je 1632. godine kao grobnica za omiljenu ženu mogulskog cara Shah Jahana, Mumtaz Mahal. programme.desc: The episode displays the Neretva River and its importance to grow tangerine in the valley. programme.title: In India with Bettany Hughes / U Indiji s Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: The exceptional capital of the Empire of Vijayanagar from the 14th century includes the ruins of the palaces, temples, forts, shrines, halls with colonnades, water channels, guardians, checkpoints and special carriage streets. In this Hindu center of Rama, Rama allegedly met Hanuman for the first time, and the largest monolithic statue of the divinity of Elephant Ganesha is kept. Thanjavur, also known as the Tanjore, became the capital of the Chola Empire, one of the longest -running dynasties in the history of the world in the 8th century. Bettany travels to the heart of the city to reveal an incredible story of these powerful rulers. He explores the Bihadeeswarar Braci Temple from 10th century, and then travels to the nearby town of Swamamalalai, where he discovers divine statues that literally pop out of the mold. Together with the Himalayan rail of Darjeeling and the rail between Kalka and Shimle, the Nilgiri mountain railway is an extraordinary example of an innovative transportation system on uneven and challenging terrain. Bettany enjoys a amazing journey between Mettupalayama and Udhagamandal, a pleasant ride across the Tamil Nadu hill. Arriving at the final destination high in the mountains, he meets a unique people of Toda, who still celebrates the arrival of the train, which has forever changed their way of life. Bettanyno's journey south India takes her to the glittering state of Kerara. There he testifies to the extraordinary dance of Theyattam, typical of this region. The holy dancers visit villages and temples, dressed in rich costumes and vividly colored bodies, and embodies gods and goddesses in music scenes that last all night. Bettanyna an adventure on the Malabar coast ends on one of the famous housing ships. Sailing the channels, she explores the ancient trade of spices that shaped the landscape and the history of India. / Iznimna prijestolnica Carstva Vijayanagara iz 14. stoljeća obuhvaća ruševine palača, hramova, utvrda, svetišta, dvorane s kolonadama, vodene kanale, stražarnice, kontrolne točke i posebne ulice za kočije. U ovom hinduističkom središtu Rama je navodno prvi put susreo Hanumana, a čuva se i najveći monolitni kip božanstva slona Ganesha. Thanjavur, također poznat kao Tanjore, u 8. je stoljeću postao prijestolnica Carstva Chola, jedne od najdugovječnijih dinastija u povijesti svijeta. Bettany putuje u srce grada kako bi otkrila nevjerojatnu priču o ovim moćnim vladarima. Istražuje hram Brihadeeswarar iz 10. stoljeća, a zatim putuje u obližnji gradić Swamimalai, gdje otkriva božanske kipove koji doslovno iskaču iz kalupa. Zajedno s Himalajskom željeznicom Darjeeling i željeznicom između Kalke i Shimle, planinska željeznica Nilgiri izvanredan je primjer inovativnog sustava prijevoza na neravnu i izazovnu terenu. Bettany uživa u zadivljujućem putovanju između Mettupalayama i Udhagamandalama, ugodnoj vožnji preko brežuljaka Tamil Nadua. Stigavši na konačno odredište visoko u planinama, susreće jedinstveni narod Toda, koji još uvijek slavi dolazak vlaka što je zauvijek promijenio njihov način života. Bettanyno putovanje južnom Indijom vodi je u blistavu državu Kerala. Ondje svjedoči izvanrednom plesu theyattam, tipičnom za ovu regiju. Sveti plesači obilaze sela i hramove, odjeveni u bogate kostime i živopisno obojenih tijela, te utjelovljuju bogove i boginje u glazbenim prizorima koji traju cijelu noć. Bettanyna avantura na Malabarskoj obali završava na jednom od poznatih brodova za stanovanje. Ploveći kanalima ona istražuje drevnu trgovinu začinima koja je oblikovala krajolik i povijest Indije.

programme.title: Ekpona / Eko zona
programme.desc: Work is underway to revitalize the arboretum of brick in the municipality of Vinica near Varaždin. It is in this ancient region that the economy of the Kovac family is located, which has a high -planned Scottish cattle in open pastures in free cultivation. A pearl series of islands and islets called the Hell Islands is a protected nature monument in the category of significant landscape since 1968. U povodu tog projekta nedavno je održana i uvodna konferencija. Jaškovo je maleno naselje u sastavu grada Ozlja u Karlovačkoj županiji. programme.title: In India with Bettany Hughes / U Indiji s Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: The Bettany's trip starts in one of the most tallest cities of the subcontinent _ Varanasia. Hindus believes that death in Varanasia and cremation on the banks of the Ganges river allows the cycle of re-birth to interrupt, and salvation achieves. Fatehpur Skri is conceived as an imperial capital of the Mogulski Carkarkar. His new city was bigger than London, but he was inhabited only 14 years. Bettany explores his empty palaces, temples and private pavilions _ at the same time revealing a unique worldview of the man who built them. Bettany goes around the Udaipur Palace. He goes to the boat to the Lake Palace, an extraordinary royal residence located on the island in the shining Lake Pichola. The amazing palace is decorated with massive marble slabs with inserted rubes, onyx, jade and carnella _ that allegedly served as inspiration for decorations within that mahala. The legendary treasure and monument of love, Taj Mahal, was built in 1632. As a tomb for a favorite woman of the Mogulski Emperor Shah Restrained, Mumtaz Mahal. Bettany goes out in front of a bright white marble structure to reveal the intriguing secret _ how they are neglected and oversetting the world-famous mausoleum once a haven of love and loss. In the city of Amritsar, the amazing beautiful temple creates an illusion to hover at the center of St. Lake. Gurudwara is the latest pilgrimage place for Sikhe, but the temple is open for pilgrims of all faiths and offers food to each visitors from the largest free kitchen in the world. / Bettanyno putovanje počinje u jednom od najsvetijih gradova potkontinenta _ Varanasiju. Hindusi vjeruju da smrt u Varanasiju i kremiranje na obalama rijeke Ganges omogućuje da se ciklus ponovnog rađanja prekine, a spasenje ostvari. Fatehpur Sikri zamišljen je kao carska prijestolnica mogulskog cara Akbara. Njegov novi grad bio je veći od Londona, no bio je naseljen samo 14 godina. Bettany istražuje njegove prazne palače, hramove i privatne paviljone _ istovremeno otkrivajući jedinstven svjetonazor čovjeka koji ih je izgradio. Bettany obilazi palače Udaipura. Odlazi čamcem do Jezerske palače, izvanredne kraljevske rezidencije smještene na otoku u blistavom jezeru Pichola. Zadivljujuća palača ukrašena je masivnim mramornim pločama s umetnutim rubinima, oniksom, žadom i karneolom _ koji su navodno poslužili kao inspiracija za ukrase unutar Taj Mahala. Legendarno blago i spomenik ljubavi, Taj Mahal, izgrađen je je 1632. godine kao grobnica za omiljenu ženu mogulskog cara Shah Jahana, Mumtaz Mahal. Bettany izlazi ispred građevine od blistavo bijelog mramora kako bi otkrila intrigantnu tajnu _ kako su zapušteni i zarasli vrtovi koji okružuju svjetski poznati mauzolej nekoć bili utočišta ljubavi i gubitka. U gradu Amritsar zadivljujuće lijepi hram stvara iluziju da lebdi u središtu svetog jezera. Gurudwara je najsvetije hodočasničko mjesto za Sikhe, no hram je otvoren za hodočasnike svih vjera i nudi hranu svakom posjetitelju iz najveće besplatne kuhinje na svijetu.

programme.title: AGATHE CHRISTIE TRAVELS WITH SIR David Suchet / Putovanja Agathe Christie sa Sir Davidom Suchetom
programme.desc: Sir David Suchet followed Agath Christie to Australia, recreating her journey to Tasmania and in Melbourne in 1922. She will see that Agathin's glory has expanded by publishing the novel a mysterious opponent and will visit the jam factory, a power plant and a spacious estate she visited a century ago. / Sir David Suchet prati Agathu Christie u Australiju, rekreirajući njezino putovanje na Tasmaniju i u Melbourne 1922. godine. Vidjet će kako se Agathina slava proširila objavljivanjem romana Tajanstveni protivnik te će posjetiti tvornicu pekmeza, elektranu i prostrano imanje koje je ona posjetila prije jednog stoljeća.

programme.title: Good children / Dobra djeca
programme.desc: After the death of the mother, a middle -aged brother and sister who have not seen each other for years, spending three days cleaning their family home _ as well as their relationship. Polako se opet počinju ponašati kao djeca...

programme.title: Proof of innocence / Dokaz nevinosti
programme.desc: Wanting to discover the truth at all costs, Joe is being escaped. In order to understand what is happening to him, Joe must peek into the distant past. programme.title: Inspector Lynley / Inspektor Lynley
programme.desc: When a children's corpse is discovered on the land of a lavish villa in Italy, parents in England seem to have finally found peace from the past. Their child was abducted 15 years ago and never found. Lynley, a family friend, who then played a supporting role in the investigation, goes to Italy to be with his family. After starting a relationship with her already adult daughter of her friends Julia, she was killed in her apartment in Rome, and Lynley becomes the main suspect for the murder. Lynley is convinced that Julia's death was somehow related to his brother's abduction 15 years ago. Is Sullivan, a man who was helping Lynley to condemn for a crime 15 years ago, really innocent as he had always claimed? / Kad se na zemljištu raskošne vile u Italiji otkrije dječje truplo, roditeljima u Engleskoj čini se da su duhovi iz prošlosti napokon našli mir. Njihovo je dijete oteto prije 15 godina i nikad nije nađeno. Lynley, obiteljski prijatelj, koji je tada odigrao sporednu ulogu u istrazi, odlazi u Italiju kako bi bio uz obitelj. Nakon što započne vezu s danas već odraslom kćeri svojih prijatelja Julijom, ona je ubijena u svome stanu u Rimu, a Lynley postaje glavni osumnjičenik za ubojstvo. Lynley je uvjeren da je Julijina smrt nekako povezana s bratovom otmicom prije 15 godina. Je li Sullivan, čovjek kojega je Lynley pomogao osuditi za zločin prije 15 godina, doista nevin kako je oduvijek tvrdio?

programme.title: Goldberg family / Obitelj Goldberg

Barry was diagnosed with a shameful health condition and asked Geoff and Eric to take care of him. Budući da je zahtjevan i djetinjast, vikend s njime mladome paru pruži uvid u odgajanje djeteta _ i prestravi ih.

programme.title: A silent rogue / Tihi skitnica
programme.desc: The story of Virgili Skestic, one of the greatest Croatian graphic artist painters. He was born in the village of Kolo near Tomislavgrad. After completing his studies of fine arts in Zagreb, in 1967 he moved to Paris, where he acted until his death in 2009. It is an artist who has declared French art criticism one of the largest graphics of the 20th century. He left behind a great artistic oeuvre and thousands of pages of a personal diary that led to death. His works are exhibited in all relevant world museums _ from France, Japan, Belgium, the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, across the US and Canada. Virgilia Brides made hundreds of oils, drawings, pastel, ceramics and more than 10,000 graphics plates in his life. He is the author of several collections of poetry. He was friends with great literary sizes and Nobel ladies such as Pablo Neruda, Ezra Pound, Samuel Beckett, Andrea de Richaud, Dragutin Tadijanovic, Zlatko Tomicic, Zvonimir Balog, Pierra Seghers. He also worked for them large graphic folders. / Priča o Virgiliju Nevjestiću, jednom od najvećih hrvatskih slikara grafičara. Rođen je u selu Kolo kod Tomislavgrada. Nakon završetka studija likovne umjetnosti u Zagrebu, 1967. seli se u Pariz, gdje djeluje do svoje smrti 2009. godine. Radi se o umjetniku kojeg je francuska likovna kritika proglasila jednim od najvećih grafičara 20. stoljeća. Iza sebe je ostavio veliki umjetnički opus i na tisuće stranica osobnog dnevnika koji je vodio do smrti. Njegova djela su izložena u svim relevantnim svjetskim muzejima _ od Francuske, Japana, Belgije, Velike Britanije, Njemačke, Švicarske, preko SAD-a i Kanade. Virgilije Nevjestić je za života napravio na stotine ulja, crteža, pastela, keramike i više od 10.000 grafičkih ploča. Autor je nekoliko zbirki poezije. Prijateljevao je s velikim književnim veličinama i nobelovcima poput Pabla Nerude, Ezre Pounda, Samuela Becketta, Andrea de Richauda, Dragutina Tadijanovića, Zlatka Tomičića, Zvonimir Baloga, Pierra Seghersa. Za njih je također radio i velike grafičke mape.

programme.title: Wonderful world of design: new streets / Čudesni svijet dizajna: Nove ulice
programme.desc: Vineet, Simmi, Prabhjot and Shalini are part of a community of friends who met while living in Slough. One by one, friends move to Graven Hill, the first village in the UK to be built on their own. In order to build their new home, Vineet and Simmi are hiring a friend from the community and blurred the border between friendship and work, and the situation becomes even more complicated when in the middle of the Vineet project changes his mind about the schedule of the Upper Kata. Prabhjot and Shalina's new building should be a super -speeding house that should be built in a few weeks, so carefully thought out and planned, perfectly designed for their needs. But when you have such a close community, their home will have to consider not only their taste, but also that of their friends ... / Vineet, Simmi, Prabhjot i Shalini dio su zajednice prijatelja koji su se upoznali dok su živjeli u Sloughu. Jedan po jedan, prijatelji se sele u Graven Hill, prvo selo u Velikoj Britaniji koje se samostalno gradi. Kako bi izgradili svoj novi dom, Vineet i Simmi angažiraju prijatelja iz zajednice te pritom zamagljuju granicu između prijateljstva i posla, a situacija postaje još kompliciranija kada usred projekta Vineet promijeni mišljenje o rasporedu gornjeg kata. Prabhjotova i Shalinina novogradnja trebala bi biti superbrza montažna kuća koja bi trebala biti izgrađena za nekoliko tjedana, stoga i pomno promišljena te planirana, savršeno dizajnirana za njihove potrebe. No kad imate tako blisku zajednicu, njihov će dom morati uzeti u obzir ne samo njihov ukus, nego i onaj njihovih prijatelja...

programme.desc: Jason Williams goes to the Malver Spring Garden Fair where he peeks behind the scenes of this year's prominent gardens. Helen Cross shares practical tips on how to get children interested in gardening. / Jason Williams odlazi na Malvernski proljetni vrtni sajam gdje zaviruje iza kulisa ovogodišnjih istaknutih vrtova. Martha Swales nas vodi korak po korak u izradi jezerca za vrtnu faunu, čime ćete prirodu dovesti do svojih vrata. Helen Cross dijeli praktične savjete o tome kako djecu zainteresirati za vrtlarenje.

programme.desc: Gregg will explore the city that is at their fingertips for three filled days. The Dutch capital is one of the most beautiful cities in Europe. programme.title: Austrian mountain villages / Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: Located between the Inna Valley, the Bavarian Predalp and the picturesque Achene Lake, the Brandenberg Alps in Tyrolean Unterland rise, where Christoph Muhlegger is engaged in a traditional mountainous economy. In the copper boiler, the traditional thyrola gray cheese is preparing. And the young farmer Stefan Mauracher in Thiersee tries to connect tradition and modernity by showing consumers that you can enjoy high quality domestic products. / Smještene između doline Inna, Bavarskih Predalpa i slikovitog Ahenskog jezera, uzdižu se Brandenberške Alpe u Tirolskom Unterlandu gdje se Christoph Muhlegger bavi tradicionalnim planinskim gospodarstvom. U bakrenu kotlu priprema tradicionalan tirolski sivi sir. The choice for the Eurovision song is facing new problems because of Israel's participation, while fans Bruce Springsteen Hrle in theaters because of the new movie about his life. Luka Šulić and Neno Belan are taking care of a breath of good domestic music this week! / Taylor Swift još jednom ima najprodavaniji album na svijetu, a posrnuli glazbeni mogul Diddy mora u zatvor na izdržavanje četverogodišnje kazne. Izbor za pjesmu Eurovizije suočava se s novim problemima zbog sudjelovanja Izraela, dok obožavatelji Brucea Springsteena hrle u kina zbog novog filma o njegovu životu. Za dašak dobre domaće glazbe ovoga se tjedna brinu Luka Šulić i Neno Belan!

programme.title: Who wants to be a millionaire? / Tko želi biti milijunaš?
programme.desc: "Who wants to be a millionaire?" Provides a unique opportunity to realize dreams _ and winning a monetary amount that can change everything. Can contestants endure under pressure, with a million reasons to give the best of themselves in the world's most successful game show? In the millionaire, general knowledge blends with human nature _ concentration, strategy and mental strength of the individual. Each question raises the stake, and the boundaries are moving from the answer to answer. Will it be able to reach the very end and willing to say, "That's my final answer!"? / "Tko želi biti milijunaš?" pruža jedinstvenu priliku za ostvarenje snova _ i osvajanje novčanog iznosa koji može promijeniti sve. Mogu li natjecatelji izdržati pod pritiskom, s milijun razloga da daju najbolje od sebe u najuspješnijem svjetskom game showu? U Milijunašu opće znanje stapaju se s ljudskom prirodom _ koncentracijom, strategijom i mentalnom snagom pojedinca. Svako pitanje podiže ulog, a granice se pomiču iz odgovora u odgovor. Hoće li uspjeti doći do samog kraja i spremno reći: "To je moj konačni odgovor!"?

programme.title: Maze / Labirint
programme.desc: Not so long ago it wasn't enough, today sixty years later we throw it in large quantities. With about 300,000 tons of thrown food, Croatia is an average of the EU annually, but at the very top when it comes to throwing food from households. Why do we buy excessively and then throw it, how much euros so end up in the basket, how to better plan and save? / Još ne tako davno nije je bilo dovoljno, danas šezdesetak godina poslije bacamo je u velikim količinama. S oko 300.000 tona bačene hrane godišnje Hrvatska je u prosjeku EU ali je zato pri samom vrhu kada je riječ o bacanju hrane iz kućanstava. Zašto prekomjerno kupujemo a onda bacamo, koliko eura tako završi u košu, kako bolje planirati i pri tome uštedjeti?

programme.title: Recreation / Rekreacija
programme.desc: Recreation is a show dedicated to a healthy and active lifestyle and a whole lifestyle related to recreational activities. It is intended for a wider active community, with the aim of encouraging regular physical activity and health care. / Rekreacija je emisija posvećena zdravom i aktivnom načinu života te cjelokupnom lifestyleu vezanom uz rekreativne aktivnosti. Namijenjena je široj aktivnoj zajednici, s ciljem poticanja na redovitu tjelesnu aktivnost i brigu o zdravlju.

programme.title: Stories from Croatia / Priče iz Hrvatske
programme.desc: The show brings adverbs on people, their interests, blends and inspiring life moments. Through intimate and incentive stories reveals the wealth of everyday life that is often lost in the noise of the day. / Emisija donosi priloge o ljudima, njihovim interesima, podvizima i inspirativnim životnim trenucima. Kroz intimne i poticajne priče otkriva bogatstvo svakodnevice koje se često izgubi u buci dana.

programme.title: Hit of the day / Hit dana
programme.desc: In the hit of the day every working day is the latest from the Croatian music scene. Introducing the latest songs of the popular, entertaining and tamburitza songs of Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: In India with Bettany Hughes / U Indiji s Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: The exceptional capital of the Empire of Vijayanagar from the 14th century includes the ruins of the palaces, temples, forts, shrines, halls with colonnades, water channels, guardians, checkpoints and special carriage streets. In this Hindu center of Rama, Rama allegedly met Hanuman for the first time, and the largest monolithic statue of the divinity of Elephant Ganesha was kept. Thanjavur, also known as the Tanjore, became the capital of the Chola Empire, one of the longest -running dynasties in the history of the world in the 8th century. Bettany travels to the heart of the city to reveal an incredible story of these powerful rulers. He explores the Bihadeeswarar Braci Temple from 10th century, and then travels to the nearby town of Swamamalalai, where he discovers divine statues that literally pop out of the mold. Together with the Himalayan rail of Darjeeling and the rail between Kalka and Shimle, the Nilgiri mountain railway is an extraordinary example of an innovative transportation system on uneven and challenging terrain. Bettany enjoys a amazing journey between Mettupalayama and Udhagamandal, a pleasant ride across the Tamil Nadu hill. Arriving at the final destination high in the mountains, he meets a unique people of Toda, who still celebrates the arrival of the train, which has forever changed their way of life. Bettanyno's journey south India takes her to the glittering state of Kerara. There he testifies to the extraordinary dance of Theyattam, typical of this region. The holy dancers visit villages and temples, dressed in rich costumes and vividly colored bodies, and embodies gods and goddesses in music scenes that last all night. Bettanyna an adventure on the Malabar coast ends on one of the famous housing ships. Sailing the channels, she explores the ancient trade of spices that shaped the landscape and the history of India. / Iznimna prijestolnica Carstva Vijayanagara iz 14. stoljeća obuhvaća ruševine palača, hramova, utvrda, svetišta, dvorane s kolonadama, vodene kanale, stražarnice, kontrolne točke i posebne ulice za kočije. U ovom hinduističkom središtu Rama je navodno prvi put susreo Hanumana, a čuva se i najveći monolitni kip božanstva slona Ganesha. Thanjavur, također poznat kao Tanjore, u 8. je stoljeću postao prijestolnica Carstva Chola, jedne od najdugovječnijih dinastija u povijesti svijeta. Bettany putuje u srce grada kako bi otkrila nevjerojatnu priču o ovim moćnim vladarima. Istražuje hram Brihadeeswarar iz 10. stoljeća, a zatim putuje u obližnji gradić Swamimalai, gdje otkriva božanske kipove koji doslovno iskaču iz kalupa. Zajedno s Himalajskom željeznicom Darjeeling i željeznicom između Kalke i Shimle, planinska željeznica Nilgiri izvanredan je primjer inovativnog sustava prijevoza na neravnu i izazovnu terenu. Bettany uživa u zadivljujućem putovanju između Mettupalayama i Udhagamandalama, ugodnoj vožnji preko brežuljaka Tamil Nadua. Stigavši na konačno odredište visoko u planinama, susreće jedinstveni narod Toda, koji još uvijek slavi dolazak vlaka što je zauvijek promijenio njihov način života. Bettanyno putovanje južnom Indijom vodi je u blistavu državu Kerala. Ondje svjedoči izvanrednom plesu theyattam, tipičnom za ovu regiju. Sveti plesači obilaze sela i hramove, odjeveni u bogate kostime i živopisno obojenih tijela, te utjelovljuju bogove i boginje u glazbenim prizorima koji traju cijelu noć. Bettanyna avantura na Malabarskoj obali završava na jednom od poznatih brodova za stanovanje. Ploveći kanalima ona istražuje drevnu trgovinu začinima koja je oblikovala krajolik i povijest Indije.

programme.title: Talk for a reason / Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: Guest is one of the most important and read French writers Leila Slimani. Honestly and without hesitation, he will explain to us why identity perceives as a moral and ethical question. How did she answer the question _ who am I? What detects us more, our social status or national identity? Why was her own family served as an inspiration for the trilogy "in the country of others" and why did she decide to tell that story of Morocco? How to look at the immigrant policy of the European Union and what are the mistakes of integration? Why doesn't it matter that others love her? What is it like to live in the country of others is a question that gives us a reason to talk to Leil Slimani. / Gošća je jedna od najvažnijih i najčitanijih francuskih književnica Leila Slimani. Iskreno i bez zadrške objasnit će nam zašto identit doživljava kao moralno i etičko pitanje. Kako je sebi odgovorila na pitanje _ tko sam ja? Što nas više određuje, naš socijalni status ili nacionalni identitet? Zašto joj je kao inspiracija za trilogiju "U zemlji drugih" poslužila vlastita obitelj i zašto je odlučila ispričati baš tu priču o Maroku? Kako gleda na imigrantsku politiku Europske unije i koje su greške integracije? Zašto joj nije važno da je drugi vole? Kako je živjeti u zemlji drugih, pitanje je koje nam daje razlog za razgovor s Leilom Slimani.

programme.desc: Each week, passionate readers, critics and theorists talk about one title currently read in Croatia. / Svaki tjedan strastveni čitatelji, kritičari i teoretičari razgovaraju o jednom naslovu koji se trenutačno čita u Hrvatskoj.
