programme.title: Collibrić / Kolibrić
programme.desc: Nonlinear story about Marca Carrere's life, which stretches for sixty years. Although the tragedies and various adversity, Marco manages to avoid chaos in their environment, such as the colibrator, focusing all its energy to "stand in place". The shop includes three generations of one family, whose life stories are overrated by the experiences of happiness, excitement, but also disappointments and pain. / Nelinearna priča o životu Marca Carrere, koja se proteže na šezdeset godina. Iako ga prate tragedije i razne nedaće, Marco uspijeva izbjeći kaos u svom okruženju, poput kolibrića, fokusirajući svu svoju energiju na to da "stoji na mjestu". Radnja obuhvaća tri generacije jedne obitelji, čije su životne priče premrežene iskustvima sreće, uzbuđenja, ali i razočarenja i boli.

programme.title: Simpsons / Simpsoni
programme.desc: Ayo! Nedu and Homer Life is further complicated in the tense finish of the Simplifix's prestigious criminal triller. / Ajoj! Nedu i Homeru život se dodatno zakomplicira u napetoj završnici Simplifixova prestižnog kriminalističkog trilera.

programme.title: Opera Selecta Festival: Soloists Bolt theater - Kamerlengo Fortress in Trogir / Festival Opera Selecta: Solisti Boljšoj teatra - Tvrđava Kamerlengo u Trogiru
programme.desc: The thirteenth edition of the important classical music festival and the cultural and music brand of the City of Trogir _ Opera Selecta brings us the opera gala concert from 2021, whose recording of HRT shows, which featured the stars of Bolšoj Theater. These are: Olga Seliverstova (Soprano), Svetlana Shilova (Mezzo -soprano) and Konstantin Shushakov (Bariton) with the piano support of the prominent Croatian pianist Vesna Podrug Kossjanenko. The most famous opera arias, duets and solo songs of N. Roman-Korsakova, P. I. Tchaikovsky, C. Gounoda, G. Donizetti, F. Lehara, J. Offenbach and G. Bizet performed for the Trogir audience. The Opera Selecta Festival has been moving to one of the most prestigious summer music events in the Adriatic, and the fort or tower of Kamerlengo has hosted dozens of top performers. / Trinaesto izdanje važnog festivala klasične glazbe i kulturno-glazbeni brend grada Trogira _ Opera Selecta, donosi nam operni gala koncert iz 2021., čiju snimku HRT prikazuje, a na kojemu su nastupile zvijezde Boljšoj teatra. To su: Olga Seliverstova (sopran), Svetlana Shilova (mezzosopran) te Konstantin Shushakov (bariton) uz glasovirsku podršku istaknute hrvatske pijanistice Vesne Podrug Kossjanenko. Za trogirsku publiku izveli su najpoznatije operne arije, duete i solo pjesme N. Rimski-Korsakova, P. I. Čajkovskog, C. Gounoda, G. Donizettija, F. Lehara, J. Offenbacha i G. Bizeta. Festival Opera Selecta prometnuo se u jedan od najprestižnijih ljetnih glazbenih događaja na Jadranu, a tvrđava ili kula Kamerlengo ugostila je na desetke vrhunskih izvođača.

programme.title: Croatian water treasure / Hrvatsko vodeno blago
programme.desc: The closest to the sky, illuminated by the sun, Milovan clouds worn winds, with thunder scars, locked snow in the wild in which only a few survive. Full of large stone blocks of desolate and impassable paths, pushed by dense forests and meadows, hidden widows and pits, North Velebit National Park with its 109 kilometers of square mystical and remembered niches to those who find peace in the listening of silence. Starting from Velika and Mali Zavizan, Rajinac, through the Hajduk and Rozan hips, we fly along the crossing of Alan and Dundovic to the end of the Premuzic track to the end to the end, to Stirovaca. Constantly thirsty for water that runs into a dark and mystical underground in which we only know some steps. Most of these waters will end their trip to the sea that mourns him. We will travel across the tops of the Velebit Breče, to pass the Premužić path, to meet the most beautiful flowers of Velebit, to peek into his animal world. Go through the water at the underground. To feel the spirit of tradition, to go with wolf traces and to witness the struggle of stone and fire. / Najbliži nebu, obasjan suncem, milovan oblacima nošenim vjetrovima, s ožiljcima od gromova, zaključan snjegovima u divljini u kojoj samo rijetki preživljavaju. Prepun velikih kamenih blokova pustih i neprohodnih staza, prošaran gustim šumama i livadama, skrovitim udolinama i jamama, Nacionalni park Sjeverni Velebit sa svojih 109 kilometara četvornih mistična je i sjetna niša onima koji u osluškivanju tišine pronalaze mir. Krenuvši od Velikog i Malog Zavižana, Rajinca, preko Hajdučkih i Rožanskih kukova, uzduž Premužićeve staze letimo prema prijelazu Alan i Dundović Mirovu pa do kraja, do Štirovače. Stalno žedan vode koja mu bježi u mračno i mistično podzemlje u kojemu tek neke korake znamo. Većina tih voda završit će svoje putovanje u moru koje ga oplakuje. Putovat ćemo preko vrhova presvučenih velebitskim brečama, proći Premužićevom stazom, upoznati najljepše cvjetove Velebita, zaviriti u njegov životinjski svijet. Krenuti putem vode u podzemlje. Osjetiti duh tradicije, krenuti vučjim tragovima i svjedočiti borbi kamena i vatre.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelj, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: Ceremony / Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore together and discover the world around us, learn about ourselves and others. We learn in play, in songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuh every morning, every day from 6.30am to 1pm. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: A collector of sounds / Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories of sound, which are heard through the ears of a small but very active being called "sound collector", which has a passion for sound and all the concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he hears very poorly. This small being spends his days discovering and learning new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are the most common sounds of the sea, sounds that produce beings in the sea, the sounds produced by insects, including snoring his best friend and pet Marta. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The mayor of Goodway and Humdinger, and the hen, invaded an icy trouble during fishing. // Kaubojka Beryl leads an exciting pattern challenge on the Wingnuts Farm! / Gradonačelnici Goodway i Humdinger, te Kokoška, upadnu u ledenu nevolju tijekom ribolova. // Kaubojka Beryl vodi Uzbudljivi Rodeo Izazov na farmi Wingnutsa!

programme.title: It's time for Timmy / Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just been three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the herd, he used to being all over his. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. In each episode, one day is shown in kindergarten. The daily routine of the only crazy toddler disrupts. Through various events and accidents, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki / Krceki
programme.desc: Krceki is a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanuts. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they fall into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem, they always invent a machine. The machine does not always work the way they imagined and emerge many humorous and unforeseen situations. We wish you a great party with Krcek! You are also awaiting rhymes and computer games! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: In addition to the animated series of Krceki, we are also coming to us by seven rhymes: bragger, plack, smart, good, angry, shy and brave. Each rhyme sings about the features of one character from the Krceki series. Music, Verses, Performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Authors of the series: Denis Alenta, Vjekoslav Zivkovic, Marija Ivsic Editor: Sanja Nakic / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić

programme.title: Ceremony / Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore together and discover the world around us, learn about ourselves and others. We learn in play, in songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: The worst witch / Najgora vještica

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Croatian water treasure / Hrvatsko vodeno blago
programme.desc: The closest to the sky, illuminated by the sun, Milovan clouds worn winds, with thunder scars, locked snow in the wild in which only a few survive. Full of large stone blocks of desolate and impassable paths, pushed by dense forests and meadows, hidden widows and pits, North Velebit National Park with its 109 kilometers of square mystical and remembered niches to those who find peace in the listening of silence. Starting from Velika and Mali Zavizan, Rajinac, through the Hajduk and Rozan hips, we fly along the crossing of Alan and Dundovic to the end of the Premuzic track to the end to the end, to Stirovaca. Constantly thirsty for water that runs into a dark and mystical underground in which we only know some steps. Most of these waters will end their trip to the sea that mourns him. We will travel across the tops of the Velebit Breče, to pass the Premužić path, to meet the most beautiful flowers of Velebit, to peek into his animal world. Go through the water at the underground. To feel the spirit of tradition, to go with wolf traces and to witness the struggle of stone and fire. / Najbliži nebu, obasjan suncem, milovan oblacima nošenim vjetrovima, s ožiljcima od gromova, zaključan snjegovima u divljini u kojoj samo rijetki preživljavaju. Prepun velikih kamenih blokova pustih i neprohodnih staza, prošaran gustim šumama i livadama, skrovitim udolinama i jamama, Nacionalni park Sjeverni Velebit sa svojih 109 kilometara četvornih mistična je i sjetna niša onima koji u osluškivanju tišine pronalaze mir. Krenuvši od Velikog i Malog Zavižana, Rajinca, preko Hajdučkih i Rožanskih kukova, uzduž Premužićeve staze letimo prema prijelazu Alan i Dundović Mirovu pa do kraja, do Štirovače. Stalno žedan vode koja mu bježi u mračno i mistično podzemlje u kojemu tek neke korake znamo. Većina tih voda završit će svoje putovanje u moru koje ga oplakuje. Putovat ćemo preko vrhova presvučenih velebitskim brečama, proći Premužićevom stazom, upoznati najljepše cvjetove Velebita, zaviriti u njegov životinjski svijet. Krenuti putem vode u podzemlje. Osjetiti duh tradicije, krenuti vučjim tragovima i svjedočiti borbi kamena i vatre.

programme.title: Talk for a reason / Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: Guest is one of the most important and read French writers Leila Slimani. Honestly and without hesitation, he will explain to us why identity perceives as a moral and ethical question. How did she answer the question _ who am I? What detects us more, our social status or national identity? Why was her own family served as an inspiration for the trilogy "in the country of others" and why did she decide to tell that story of Morocco? How to look at the immigrant policy of the European Union and what are the mistakes of integration? Why doesn't it matter that others love her? What is it like to live in the country of others is a question that gives us a reason to talk to Leil Slimani. / Gošća je jedna od najvažnijih i najčitanijih francuskih književnica Leila Slimani. Iskreno i bez zadrške objasnit će nam zašto identit doživljava kao moralno i etičko pitanje. Kako je sebi odgovorila na pitanje _ tko sam ja? Što nas više određuje, naš socijalni status ili nacionalni identitet? Zašto joj je kao inspiracija za trilogiju "U zemlji drugih" poslužila vlastita obitelj i zašto je odlučila ispričati baš tu priču o Maroku? Kako gleda na imigrantsku politiku Europske unije i koje su greške integracije? Zašto joj nije važno da je drugi vole? Kako je živjeti u zemlji drugih, pitanje je koje nam daje razlog za razgovor s Leilom Slimani.

programme.title: Austrian mountain villages / Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: In Trins, an idyllic village of farmers, the Maier family with 500 silver spruce lays the foundation for their own breeding of Christmas trees, a family -owned company to which the originality of Tyrol is inherent. Just ten kilometers south of Trins, Vals Valina begins where Helga, one of the few shepherds in Tyrol, took over the Nockerlalm mountain estate from its grandfather. For several years, her skin grazes. Helga has a mission: explain as many people as possible the connection between the use of mountain pastures, cultural heritage and ensuring the living space as well as the functional mountain landscape. / U Trinsu, idiličnom selu poljodjelaca, obitelj Maier s 500 srebrnih smreka polaže temelj za vlastiti uzgoj božićnih drvca, obiteljsko poduzeće kojemu je svojstvena izvornost Tirola. Samo deset kilometara južno od Trinsa počinje dolina Vals gdje je Helga, jedna od malobrojnih pastirica u Tirolu, preuzela planinsko imanje Nockerlalm od svoga djeda. Već nekoliko godina na njemu pasu njezine koze. Helga ima misiju: objasniti što većem broju ljudi povezanost korištenja planinskih pašnjaka, kulturne baštine i osiguravanja životnog prostora kao i funkcionalnoga gorskog krajolika.

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Ballet Sergei Prokofiev in the choreography of Leo Mujić, April 26, 2025, HNK Ivan pl. Rijeka. The first ballet prime minister in the Rijeka mandate of Intendant Dubravka Vrgoc returns to the "city flowing" by his favorite choreographer Leo Mujic, to whom this is the fourth play with the Rijeka ballet. Wanting to find something known and attractive, which would return to Rijeka children on stage and ballerina "on the spots", select the Neoclassical Ballet of Sergei Prokofiev according to the famous story of Charles Perrault _ Cinderella _ premiered on the Moscow Podium of the Moscow Theater in 1945. Mangiole, who will soon give place to her colleague Leonard Jakovina. But the point is that he started the back of the dance "on the spikes", opening a series of auditions for new dancers. Here we get to know the old and new stars of the ensemble, these are Marta Voinea Cavrak (half -sister Zorica), Yurik Kimura (Ella/Cinderella), Leonard Cel (John/Prince) and Marta Kanazir (Cindy/Mother), as well as a number of children from Rijeka's dance schools. For the first time in Croatia, a young Belgian, otherwise chief Dirigent of the Ljubljana Opera, Maestro Ayrton Despelaere. / Balet Sergeja Prokofjeva u koreografiji Lea Mujića, 26. travnja 2025., HNK Ivana pl. Zajca Rijeka. Prva baletna premijera u riječkom mandatu intendantice Dubravke Vrgoč vraća u "grad koji teče" omiljenog koreografa Lea Mujića kojemu je ovo četvrta predstava s Riječkim baletom. Želeći naći nešto svima poznato i privlačno, što bi vratilo u Rijeku djecu na scenu i balerine "na špice", odabiru neoklasični balet Sergeja Prokofjeva prema poznatoj priči Charlesa Perraulta _ Pepeljugu _ praizvedenu na podiju moskovskoga Boljšoj teatra godine 1945. To je prvo predstavljanje novog, a sada već bivšeg ravnatelja Riječkog baleta, Talijana Paola Mangiole, koji će uskoro ustupiti mjesto kolegi Leonardu Jakovini. Ali bit je da je pokrenuo povratak plesa "na špicama" otvorivši niz audicija za nove plesače. Tu upoznajemo stare i nove zvijezde ansambla, to su Marta Voinea Čavrak (polusestra Zorica), Yurika Kimura (Ella/Pepeljuga), Leonard Cela (John/Princ) i Marta Kanazir (Cindy/Majka), ali i niz djece iz riječkih plesnih škola. Orkestrom prvi put u Hrvatskoj ravna mladi Belgijanac, inače šef-dirigent Ljubljanske opere, maestro Ayrton Desimpelaere.

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: As Cuba marked American culture in its entirety, Cuban music has been registered with jazz history since his early days. Today, the Afrokuban jazz is one of his great genres and one of the two pillars of the music continent named Latin Jazz, and the pianist Gonzalo Rubalcab is among his leading representatives, but also the most famous jazz-pivnists in general. He began to show the unusual tendency of Rubalcab music at the youngest age, so as a six -year -old he played drums in the orchestra of Father Guillermo. Zarana labeled as a miracle of a child, Rubalcabs will attract the attention of one of the greatest popularizers of the Afrokububan jazz and jazz _ Dizzy Gillespie, who will invite him to play with him, in the mid -1980s. Shortly thereafter, another key encounter will happen _ The one with the consistent Charlie Haden, which will significantly mark Rubalcab's musical path. Since then, Rubalcaba will achieve a glittering record and concert career, with a number of notable release from Cuban and the wider tradition of jazz such as "Nocturni" and "Land of the Sun" album. The last major recognition of Rubalcabi arrived for the album "Skyline" from 2021, which he recorded with two jazz greats Jack Dejohnette and Ron Carter. It is accompanied by an excellent "Turning Point/Trio Dete", which was joined by a great Matt Brewer and Eric Harland. In addition to Ernest Simpson as a replacement for Harland on drums, Rubalcaba presented his impressive music in early July and at a small Roman theater in Pula. / Kao što je Kuba obilježila američku kulturu u cijelosti, kubanska glazba upisana je u povijest jazza od njegovih ranih dana. Danas je afrokubanski jazz jedan od njegovih velikih žanrova i jedan od dva stupa glazbenog kontinenta po imenu Latin jazz, a pijanist Gonzalo Rubalcaba među njegovim je vodećim predstavnicima, ali i najpoznatijim jazz-pijanistima općenito. Neobičnu sklonost glazbi Rubalcaba je počeo pokazivati u najmlađoj dobi, pa je već kao šestogodišnjak zasvirao bubnjeve u orkestru oca Guillerma. Zarana označen kao čudo od djeteta, Rubalcaba će sredinom osamdesetih u Havani privući pažnju jednog od najvećih popularizatora afrokubanskog jazza i ikone jazza _ Dizzyja Gillespieja, koji će ga pozvati da s njim zasvira. Ubrzo nakon toga dogodit će se još jedan ključan susret _ onaj s konstrabasistom Charliejem Hadenom, koji će bitno obilježiti Rubalcabin glazbeni put. Otad će Rubalcaba ostvariti blistavu diskografsku i koncertnu karijeru, uz niz zapaženih izdanja izniklih iz kubanske, ali i šire tradicije jazza poput albuma "Nocturne" i "Land of the Sun". Posljednje veliko priznanje Rubalcabi je stiglo za album "Skyline" iz 2021., koji je snimio s dvama velikanima jazza Jackom DeJohnetteom i Ronom Carterom. Na njega se nadovezuje izvrsni "Turning Point/Trio Dete", na kojem su mu se pridružili sjajni Matt Brewer i Eric Harland. Uz Ernesta Simpsona kao zamjenu za Harlanda na bubnjevima, Rubalcaba je svoju impresivnu glazbu predstavio početkom srpnja i u Malom rimskom kazalištu u Puli.

programme.title: Monika Leskovar and HRT Symphony Orchestra under the direction of Pascal Rophea - KD V. Lisinski / Monika Leskovar i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Pascala Rophea - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: The HRT Symphony Orchestra opens the new season of the master cycle under the guidance of Maestro Pascal Rophe, who, with this concert, begins his second term of the chief of conductor of the esteemed orchestra. The program begins with the Singing Song of Slava (Chant du Rossignol) Igor Stravinsky, derived from his opera Slavuj (1914). Stravinski's contemporary and countryman Sergei Rahmanjin's second symphony returned his faith in a composer call after a catastrophic failure of the first symphony of 1897 and the severe creative crisis that followed. Another symphony, intended for the large composition of the symphony orchestra, with as many as three instruments each in most width sections and an extended group of percussion, contains an abundance of beautiful, swollen romantic music, but at the same time a masterfully controlled tension that is released in the magnificent final. Solistica na koncertu je jedna od naših najnagrađivanijih violončelistica, Monika Leskovar, koja je kao trinaestogodišnjakinja postala najmlađa pobjednica Međunarodnog natjecanja Čajkovski u Japanu (1995.). Rich in international careers, today he teaches at the Academy of Music in Zagreb and always gladly returns to the HRT Symphony Orchestra, and on this occasion in the interpretation of the variation on the Rokoko Theme of Petra Iljic Tchaikovsky. Although his role model were classic forms and type of orchestra from Hayn's time, Petar Iljic Tchaikovsky created more than a virtuosic and romantic gorgeous work with a prose rococo theme and complex variations in his variations. / Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a otvara novu sezonu Majstorskog ciklusa pod vodstvom maestra Pascala Rophea koji ovim koncertom počinje svoj drugi mandat šefa dirigenta cijenjenog orkestra. Program počinje simfonijskom pjesmom Pjev slavuja (Chant du rossignol) Igora Stravinskog, proizašlom iz njegove opere Slavuj (1914.). Stravinskijev suvremenik i zemljak Sergej Rahmanjinov Drugom simfonijom vratio je svoju vjeru u skladateljski poziv nakon katastrofalnog neuspjeha Prve simfonije 1897. i teške stvaralačke krize koja je uslijedila. Druga simfonija, namijenjena velikom sastavu simfonijskog orkestra, s čak po tri instrumenta u većini puhačkih sekcija i proširenom skupinom udaraljki, sadrži obilje predivne, nabujale romantičarske glazbe, ali i istovremeno majstorski kontroliranu napetost koja se oslobađa u veličanstvenom finalu. Solistica na koncertu je jedna od naših najnagrađivanijih violončelistica, Monika Leskovar, koja je kao trinaestogodišnjakinja postala najmlađa pobjednica Međunarodnog natjecanja Čajkovski u Japanu (1995.). Bogate međunarodne karijere, danas predaje na Muzičkoj akademiji u Zagrebu te se uvijek rado vraća pred Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a, a ovom prigodom u interpretaciji Varijacija na rokoko temu Petra Iljiča Čajkovskog. Iako su mu uzor bile klasične forme i tip orkestra iz Haydnova doba, Petar Iljič Čajkovski u svojim je Varijacijama stvorio više nego virtuozno i romantičarski raskošno djelo s prpošnom rokoko temom i kompleksnim varijacijama.

programme.desc: Thirteen -year -olds Leo and Remi are the best friends who spend their free time in a playful idyll, near the magic fields of Dali, grown by Leo's family. When the summer holidays are over, their closeness causes the curiosity of other students and becomes the target of mocking comments. Kada završe ljetni praznici, njihova bliskost izaziva radoznalost ostalih učenika te postaje meta podrugljivih komentara. Danas je afrokubanski jazz jedan od njegovih velikih žanrova i jedan od dva stupa glazbenog kontinenta po imenu Latin jazz, a pijanist Gonzalo Rubalcaba među njegovim je vodećim predstavnicima, ali i najpoznatijim jazz-pijanistima općenito. Neobičnu sklonost glazbi Rubalcaba je počeo pokazivati u najmlađoj dobi, pa je već kao šestogodišnjak zasvirao bubnjeve u orkestru oca Guillerma. Zarana označen kao čudo od djeteta, Rubalcaba će sredinom osamdesetih u Havani privući pažnju jednog od najvećih popularizatora afrokubanskog jazza i ikone jazza _ Dizzyja Gillespieja, koji će ga pozvati da s njim zasvira. Ubrzo nakon toga dogodit će se još jedan ključan susret _ onaj s konstrabasistom Charliejem Hadenom, koji će bitno obilježiti Rubalcabin glazbeni put. Otad će Rubalcaba ostvariti blistavu diskografsku i koncertnu karijeru, uz niz zapaženih izdanja izniklih iz kubanske, ali i šire tradicije jazza poput albuma "Nocturne" i "Land of the Sun". Posljednje veliko priznanje Rubalcabi je stiglo za album "Skyline" iz 2021., koji je snimio s dvama velikanima jazza Jackom DeJohnetteom i Ronom Carterom. Na njega se nadovezuje izvrsni "Turning Point/Trio Dete", na kojem su mu se pridružili sjajni Matt Brewer i Eric Harland. Uz Ernesta Simpsona kao zamjenu za Harlanda na bubnjevima, Rubalcaba je svoju impresivnu glazbu predstavio početkom srpnja i u Malom rimskom kazalištu u Puli.

programme.title: Split Blues Festival / Split Blues Festival
programme.desc: As part of the 11th Split Blues Festival, the Croatian Bluesers from the Homeland and Diaspora held a full -time concert. Thus, Croatian Blues performers from Amsterdam, Bologna, London, Paris, as well as from Velika Gorica, Zabok, Sisak, Split, Rogoznica, Lepoglava, Zagreb, Hvar, Solina, Veliki Trgovišće performed: Tony Lee King And Southern Cooking and Charlie and Bell Blues Experience, which are this year's winners of Croatian Blues Challenge and Croatian representatives at the World Blues Competition in Memphis. / U sklopu 11. Split Blues Festivala cjelovečernje koncerte održali su hrvatski blueseri iz domovine i dijaspore. Tako su na istoj pozornici u splitskom Đardinu prodefilirali hrvatski izvođači bluesa iz Amsterdama, Bologne, Londona, Pariza, ali i iz Velike Gorice, Zaboka, Siska, Splita, Rogoznice, Lepoglave, Čiova, Zagreba, Hvara, Solina, Velikog Trgovišća... Nastupili su: Tony Lee King, Tomislav Goluban, Harpoon Blues Band, Francesco And Southern Cooking te Charlie And Bell Blues Experience koji su ovogodišnji pobjednici Croatian Blues Challengea i predstavnici Hrvatske na svjetskom blues natjecanju u Memphisu.

programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: In the first episode, we embark on geological sides with the beautiful Slavonian mountain of Papuk. With the help of scientists, our professional guides, we get to know the exceptional geological, biological and cultural and historical heritage of this mountain. What at first glance was just a piece of rock will suddenly bring us back to the Cambria period, 450 million years back, to a global event of a sudden development of life. Following the clues, we climb the time ladder and travel for millions of years of geological past. From the rest of the ancient volcanoes, through strong tectonic movements, to traces of the Pannonian Sea. Along the way we meet the famous Charug, we also visit the Geo-Info Center in Voćin through a sensational virtual walk through the geological wealth of this area. In the House of Pannonian Sea in the Great, in the attractive lineup, we also meet Carcharodon Megalodon, a twenty -meter shark that swam in the former Pannonian Sea. And so step by step, millions of years long, in the youngest tufa deposits we will see the nose of the benign Diva Regoc. Finally, we will rest at one of the most beautiful natural spaces of Papuk, in the Gorski Kotar Valley Jankovac. / U prvoj epizodi krećemo na geološke skitnje predivnom slavonskom planinom Papuk. Uz pomoć znanstvenika, naših stručnih vodiča, upoznajemo iznimnu geološku, biološku i kulturno-povijesnu baštinu ove planine. Ono što nam je na prvi pogled bio tek komad stijene odjednom će nas vratiti u razdoblje kambrija, 450 milijuna godina unatrag, u globalni događaj naglog razvoja života. Slijedeći tragove penjemo se vremenskom ljestvicom i putujemo milijunima godina geološke prošlosti. Od ostatka drevnih vulkana, preko snažnih tektonskih pokreta, do tragova Panonskoga mora. Na putu susrećemo i znamenitog Čarugu, posjećujemo i Geo-info centar u Voćinu kroz senzacionalnu virtualnu šetnju geološkim bogatstvom ovoga kraja. U Kući Panonskoga mora u Velikoj, u atraktivnom postavu susrećemo i carcharodon megalodona, dvadesetmetarskoga morskoga psa koji je plivao u nekadašnjem Panonskom moru. I tako korak po korak, dugačak milijune godina, u najmlađim naslagama sedre ugledat ćemo nos dobroćudnoga diva Regoča. Za kraj, odmorit ćemo se na jednom od najljepših prirodnih prostora Papuka, u gorskoj dolini Jankovac.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelj, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže

Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: In the first episode, we embark on geological sides with the beautiful Slavonian mountain of Papuk. With the help of scientists, our professional guides, we get to know the exceptional geological, biological and cultural and historical heritage of this mountain. What at first glance was just a piece of rock will suddenly bring us back to the Cambria period, 450 million years back, to a global event of a sudden development of life. Following the clues, we climb the time ladder and travel for millions of years of geological past. From the rest of the ancient volcanoes, through strong tectonic movements, to traces of the Pannonian Sea. Along the way we meet the famous Charug, we also visit the Geo-Info Center in Voćin through a sensational virtual walk through the geological wealth of this area. In the House of Pannonian Sea in the Great, in the attractive lineup, we also meet Carcharodon Megalodon, a twenty -meter shark that swam in the former Pannonian Sea. And so step by step, millions of years long, in the youngest tufa deposits we will see the nose of the benign Diva Regoc. Finally, we will rest at one of the most beautiful natural spaces of Papuk, in the Gorski Kotar Valley Jankovac. / U prvoj epizodi krećemo na geološke skitnje predivnom slavonskom planinom Papuk. Uz pomoć znanstvenika, naših stručnih vodiča, upoznajemo iznimnu geološku, biološku i kulturno-povijesnu baštinu ove planine. Ono što nam je na prvi pogled bio tek komad stijene odjednom će nas vratiti u razdoblje kambrija, 450 milijuna godina unatrag, u globalni događaj naglog razvoja života. Slijedeći tragove penjemo se vremenskom ljestvicom i putujemo milijunima godina geološke prošlosti. Od ostatka drevnih vulkana, preko snažnih tektonskih pokreta, do tragova Panonskoga mora. Na putu susrećemo i znamenitog Čarugu, posjećujemo i Geo-info centar u Voćinu kroz senzacionalnu virtualnu šetnju geološkim bogatstvom ovoga kraja. U Kući Panonskoga mora u Velikoj, u atraktivnom postavu susrećemo i carcharodon megalodona, dvadesetmetarskoga morskoga psa koji je plivao u nekadašnjem Panonskom moru. I tako korak po korak, dugačak milijune godina, u najmlađim naslagama sedre ugledat ćemo nos dobroćudnoga diva Regoča. Za kraj, odmorit ćemo se na jednom od najljepših prirodnih prostora Papuka, u gorskoj dolini Jankovac.

programme.title: Bernadette / Bernadette

Bernadette je očekivala da će dolaskom u Elizejsku palaču konačno dobiti mjesto koje zaslužuje, jer je svom suprugu uvijek bila potpora i pomogla mu da postane predsjednik, ali prevarila se. programme.title: Lanternist / Lanternist
programme.desc: Documentary movie about going, a lighthouse on Stončica. Ivan Bulić Ićo has been working as a lighthouse since 1995. He changed several lighthous, from Blitvenica to Palagruza. He is currently working on Stončica, a lighthouse located on the east side of Vis. Ićo has one -month shifts, he is a month in Split, where he lives, and a month on the lighthouse. The Stončica is twenty minutes away from Vis by car and a twenty minute walk in a goat path. Sometimes friends from Vis or Split come to him. In his spare time, he closed himself in his little workshop and made fish from the wooden bouquets, which he has shown several times at exhibitions in Split, Vis and Zagreb. The film shows the life of a lighthouse, and through the story of Ivan Bulic it can be seen that loneliness is not conditioned by being alone somewhere. / Dokumentarni film o Ići, svjetioničaru na Stončici. Ivan Bulić Ićo od 1995. godine radi kao svjetioničar. Promijenio je nekoliko svjetionika, od Blitvenice do Palagruže. Trenutačno radi na Stončici, svjetioniku smještenome na istočnoj strani Visa. Ićo ima jednomjesečne smjene, mjesec dana je u Splitu, gdje živi, a mjesec dana na svjetioniku. Stončica je udaljena od Visa dvadesetak minuta automobilom i još dvadesetak minuta hoda kozjom stazom. Ponekad mu dođu prijatelji iz Visa ili Splita. U slobodno vrijeme zatvori se u svoju malu radionicu i od drvenih naplavina izrađuje ribe koje je već nekoliko puta prikazao na izložbama u Splitu, Visu i Zagrebu. U filmu je prikazan život svjetioničara, a kroz priču o Ivanu Buliću vidi se da samoća nije uvjetovana time da si negdje sam.

programme.title: We were born on Morava / Rodili smo se na Moravi
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the beginning of the emigration of Moravian Croats, produced by the emissions of folk and dedicated culture by culture during 2017 and 2018, the documentary film by Davor Boric and Ljiljana Sismanovic was created. The film is reminiscent of an almost forgotten and wider Croatian public of the unknown historical fate of the Croatian minority in the Czech Republic and documents their memories and remains of the heritage of Moravian Croats, which they have been trying to record from the 1990s and revitalize. Every first Sunday in September, displaced Moravian Croats, their descendants and their friends Czechs and Germans gather at Kiritof in Jevišovka. They participate in the mass celebration, lay flowers on monuments and graves, and then hang out and remember the last days with a folklore program, eating and drinks. The Association of Citizens of Croatian National in the Czech Republic, led by brother and sister Jan Kopřiva and Lenka Kopřivová, launched in 2010. An extensive documentation project of the fate and the language of Moravian Croats, which made Lenka Kopřivová about 30 conversations with the old Moravian Croats who still speak their dialect and remember old customs, legend and details. A songbook of Moravian Croats and a CD with their songs. The documentary film with the atmosphere of Kiritof in Jevišovki, the fragments of Josef Lawitschke's life stories, Marie Šalamon and Ana Luzarov, and the narration of Lenka Kopivova, brings only the preserved folklore treasure _ "Croatian wedding", the choreography depicting the wedding customs of the Moravian Croats, and today, as well as the nation's nation of the Croats, members of the Czech Society "Palava" from Mikulov. / U povodu obilježavanja 70. obljetnice od početka iseljavanja moravskih Hrvata u produkciji emisija pučke i predajne kulture PO Kultura tijekom 2017. i 2018. godine nastajao je dokumentarni film autora Davora Borića i Ljiljane Šišmanović. Film podsjeća na gotovo zaboravljenu i široj hrvatskoj javnosti nepoznatu povijesnu sudbinu hrvatske manjine u Češkoj i dokumentira njihova sjećanja i ostatke baštine moravskih Hrvata koju od devedesetih pokušavaju zabilježiti i koliko je moguće, revitalizirati. Svake prve nedjelje u rujnu raseljeni moravski Hrvati, njihovi potomci i njihovi prijatelji Česi i Nijemci okupljaju se na Kiritofu u Jevišovki. Sudjeluju u misnom slavlju, polažu cvijeće na spomenike i grobove, a potom se druže i prisjećaju minulih dana uz folklorni program, jelo i piće. Udruga građana hrvatske narodnosti u Češkoj, koju vode brat i sestra Jan Kopřiva i Lenka Kopřivová, pokrenula je 2010. opsežan dokumentacijski projekt Sudbine i jezik moravskih Hrvata, u sklopu kojeg je Lenka Kopřivová snimila oko 30 razgovora sa starim moravskim Hrvatima koji još govore svoj dijalekt i pamte stare običaje, predaje, legende i detalje iz svakodnevnog života prije 1945. Objavljena je i pjesmarica moravskih Hrvata te CD s njihovim pjesmama. Dokumentarni film uz atmosferu Kiritofa u Jevišovki, fragmente životnih priča Josefa Lawitschke, Marie Šalamonove i Ane Luzarove, te naraciju Lenke Koprivove, donosi i jedino sačuvano folklorno blago _ "Hrvatsku svadbu", koreografiju koja prikazuje svadbene običaje moravskih Hrvata, a danas je, kao i narodne nošnje moravskih Hrvata, čuvaju i izvode članovi češkoga društva "Palava" iz Mikulova.

programme.desc: Located between the Inna Valley, the Bavarian Predalp and the picturesque Achene Lake, the Brandenberg Alps in Tyrolean Unterland rise, where Christoph Muhlegger is engaged in a traditional mountainous economy. In the copper boiler, the traditional thyrola gray cheese is preparing. And the young farmer Stefan Mauracher in Thiersee tries to connect tradition and modernity by showing consumers that you can enjoy high quality domestic products. / Smještene između doline Inna, Bavarskih Predalpa i slikovitog Ahenskog jezera, uzdižu se Brandenberške Alpe u Tirolskom Unterlandu gdje se Christoph Muhlegger bavi tradicionalnim planinskim gospodarstvom. U bakrenu kotlu priprema tradicionalan tirolski sivi sir. A mladi poljodjelac Stefan Mauracher u Thierseeu pokušava povezati tradiciju i suvremenost pokazujući potrošačima da se može uživati i u visokokvalitetnim domaćim proizvodima.

programme.title: Vatroslav Kulish - Riffs / Vatroslav Kuliš - Riffovi
programme.desc: In this documentary, we present the creativity of Vatroslav Kuliš, certainly one of the most annoying contemporary Croatian painters. The film shows a painter whose studio is not only indoors, but also outdoors, in his home, as well as the city where he lives, on the streets and squares. Kulish is a painter whose work is open to a creative process that is his daily life, in the studio, and in the city of the Atelier. This concept is read through the painter's phase from the mid-70s to the work that creates the year the show was filmed. / U ovom dokumentarnom filmu predstavljamo stvaralaštvo Vatroslava Kuliša, zacijelo jednog od najintrigantnijih suvremenih hrvatskih slikara. Film prikazuje slikara čiji atelijer nije samo u zatvorenom prostoru, već i na otvorenom, u njegovu domu, kao i gradu u kojemu živi, na ulicama i trgovima. Kuliš je slikar čije je djelo otvoren stvaralački proces koji je sam njegov svakodnevni život, u atelijeru, i u gradu _ atelijeru. Ta se koncepcija iščitava kroz slikareve faze od sredine 70-ih godina do djela koja stvara u godini kad je emisija snimana.

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: From the unique court park of Schonbrunn in Vienna, see a recording of the first part of the traditional summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of the renowned maestro of Tugan Sozhi's. On the open stage, in a carefully selected program, they will be joined by a glad guest of the world's stage tenor Piotr Beczala and for the first time one of the most famous children's choirs, the Viennese boys. The program basis of the concert is the performance of the popular arias from the operetta and the operetta and works from the rich cultural European heritage. With this free concert in the unique ambience of the Schonbrunn Palace Palace in Vienna, which has been held since 2004, this brilliant orchestra continues to follow a specific cultural goal _ approaching classical music with a wide range of listeners and arousing interest outside its usual audience. Enjoy a spectacle produced by Orf television, which follow millions of viewers around the world in eighty countries. / Iz jedinstvenog dvorskog perivoja Schonbrunn u Beču pogledajte snimku prvog dijela tradicionalnog ljetnog koncerta Bečke filharmonije pod ravnanjem renomiranog maestra Tugana Sokhijeva. Na otvorenoj pozornici, u brižljivo odabranom programu, pridružit će im se rado viđeni gost svjetskih pozornica tenor Piotr Beczala te prvi put i jedan od najpoznatijih dječjih zborova, Bečki dječaci. Programska osnova koncerta je izvođenje popularnih arija iz opera i opereta te djela iz bogatog kulturnog europskog nasljeđa. Ovim besplatnim koncertnom u jedinstvenom ambijentu perivoja palače Schonbrunn u Beču, koji se održava još od 2004. godine, ovaj briljantni orkestar nastavlja slijediti specifičan kulturni cilj _ približavanje klasične glazbe širokom spektru slušatelja i pobuđivanje zanimanja izvan svoje uobičajene publike. Uživajte u spektaklu koji producira televizija ORF, a koji prate milijuni gledatelja diljem svijeta u osamdeset zemalja.

programme.title: Minority mosaic / Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: The National Community of Bosniak Istria celebrated 30. The anniversary of the action. Through the past three decades, the communities actively worked on the preservation of Bosniak culture, tradition, customs and nurturing Bosniak identity. Three years ago, they founded the Pula and the Choir of the "Istrian Gondage", which carries out the beauty of Sevdah. / Nacionalna zajednica Bošnjaka Istre ove je godine proslavila 30. obljetnicu djelovanja. Kroz protekla tri desetljeća zajednica je aktivno radila na očuvanju bošnjačke kulture, tradicije, običaja i njegovanja bošnjačkog identiteta. With about 300,000 tons of thrown food, Croatia is an average of the EU annually, but at the very top when it comes to throwing food from households. Why do we buy excessively and then throw it, how much euros so end up in the basket, how to better plan and save? / Još ne tako davno nije je bilo dovoljno, danas šezdesetak godina poslije bacamo je u velikim količinama. S oko 300.000 tona bačene hrane godišnje Hrvatska je u prosjeku EU ali je zato pri samom vrhu kada je riječ o bacanju hrane iz kućanstava. Zašto prekomjerno kupujemo a onda bacamo, koliko eura tako završi u košu, kako bolje planirati i pri tome uštedjeti?

programme.title: The world of science / Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: The show brings the actualities, new scientific discoveries, curiosities from the animal and herbal world and social phenomena. We will peek into all the corners of the Earth, and we will not forget the rest of the universe. We bring serious, but also that casual, fun side of science. / Emisija donosi aktualnosti, nova znanstvena otkrića, zanimljivosti iz životinjskog i biljnog svijeta te društvene fenomene. Zavirit ćemo u sve kutke Zemlje, a nećemo zaboraviti ni ostatak svemira. Donosimo ozbiljnu, ali i onu ležerniju, zabavnu stranu znanosti.

programme.title: Global 3000 / Global 3000
programme.desc: Eight billion people live on Earth and we are connected better than ever before. Nove ideje o tome kako to najbolje iskoristiti, donosi Global Us.

programme.desc: Extreme is an off -road race with electric jeeps, which takes place in remote places in the world like the tropical forests of the Amazon. The purpose of the competition is to direct people to climate change in the world and the reasonable use of cars. / Екстрийм Е е офроуд състезание с електрически джипове, което се провежда в отдалечени места на света като тропическите гори на Амазонка. Целта на състезанието е да насочи хората към климатичните промени в света и разумното използване на автомобилите.

programme.desc: What determines the beginning of life? The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. Възможни ли са междугалактическите пътешествия с новата задвижваща технология?

programme.title: World Pentel World Championship / Световно първенство по модерен петобой
programme.desc: The winners of the race qualify for the Olympics. / Победителите от състезанието се класират за Олимпийските игри.

programme.title: I know that / Това го знам
programme.desc: The entertaining teenage quiz has the ambitious goal of providing viewers with a new view of the possibility of the learning material being presented in the public space through modern and interactive television games. Participants will have to overcome different challenges at every level of the game, gather lives, and especially have fun thanks to the knowledge they have gained at school. The format includes a variety of questions, logical tasks, music and a great deal of fun. All this is a gaming regulation of a video game style competition, combined with elements of the specifics of life on social networks. Participants in the children's educational program are 15 and 17 years old, and the project focuses on education as a fun process in the entertainment segment of television. / Забавно-образователната тийнейджърска викторина има амбициозната цел да предостави на зрителите нов поглед върху възможността учебният материал да бъде представен в публичното пространство чрез модерна и интерактивна телевизионна игра. Участниците ще трябва да преодоляват различни предизвикателства във всяко ниво от играта, да събират животи и най-вече да се забавляват благодарение на знанията, които са натрупали в училище. Форматът включва разнообразни въпроси, логически задачи, музика и голяма доза забавление. Всичко това е игрален регламент на състезание по знания в стилистиката на видео игра, съчетана с елементи от спецификите на живота в социалните мрежи. Участниците в детско-юношеското образователно предаване са на възраст межди 15 и 17 години, а проектът поставя фокус върху образованието като забавен процес в развлекателния сегмент на телевизионния ефир.

programme.title: Sailing: Grand Prix of a Pog / Ветроходство: Гран при на Засниц
programme.desc: The Grand Prix is ​​a well -known sailing tournament that usually attracts many competitors and viewers with its high level and dramatic wind conditions. / Гран При на Засниц е известен ветроходен турнир, който обикновено привлича много състезатели и зрители със своето високо ниво и драматични условия на вятъра.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Lyubomir Ganev / Зала на славата: Любомир Ганев
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program, 2025) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program, 2025) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program, 2025) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program, 2025) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: The policeman's niece / Die Nichte des Polizisten
programme.desc: A group of young, ambitious applicants for a special police unit in Baden-Wurttemberg are driven to peak performance. One of them is 23-year-old Rebecca Henselmann (Magdalena Laubisch), who will soon be deployed in covert operations. She works hard and is ambitious, just like her colleague Christoph Laurin (Max von der Groeben), with whom Rebecca becomes close. The young policewoman is highly motivated in operations against drug and weapons trafficking, guided by her trainer Lars Menke (Nils Strunk). In doing so, she encounters abuse of power and encounters right-wing radical attitudes in the police. Rebecca learned about the influence of right-wing extremists in her home in Thuringia through the police officer Werner Barth (Thorsten Merten). Now she finds herself caught between the fronts of organized crime and the extreme right, whose connections sometimes extend into her unity. This knowledge becomes her downfall. / Eine Gruppe von jungen, ehrgeizigen Anwarter:innen einer baden-wurttembergischen Polizei-Spezialeinheit wird zu Hochstleistungen getrieben. Eine davon ist die 23-jahrige Rebecca Henselmann (Magdalena Laubisch), die schon bald bei verdeckten Operationen eingesetzt wird. Sie strengt sich an, ist ehrgeizig, genau wie ihr Kollege Christoph Laurin (Max von der Groeben), dem Rebecca naherkommt. Hochmotiviert agiert die junge Polizistin bei Einsatzen gegen Drogen- und Waffenhandel, angeleitet von ihrem Ausbilder Lars Menke (Nils Strunk). Dabei begegnet sie Machtmissbrauch und trifft auf rechtsradikale Einstellungen auch in der Polizei. Rebecca hat in ihrer Heimat in Thuringen durch den Polizisten Werner Barth (Thorsten Merten) die Einflussnahme von Rechtsextremen kennengelernt. Nun gerat sie selbst zwischen die Fronten von organisierter Kriminalitat und extremer Rechten, deren Verbindungen teilweise bis in ihre Einheit hineinreichen. Dieses Wissen wird ihr zum Verhangnis.

programme.title: Why did Michèle Kiesewetter die? / Warum starb Michèle Kiesewetter?
programme.desc: Policewoman Michèle Kiesewetter was killed in broad daylight in the middle of a big city in 2007. Only the course of events is clear: They are taking a lunch break in their patrol car when the 22-year-old policewoman and her colleague Martin A. are shot in the head. Years later it turns out that the crimes were carried out by the right-wing extremist terrorist organization NSU. The NSU had previously carried out nine racist attacks. Then they shoot at police officers, this time not out of racial hatred. This time there must be a different motive. But which one? Why did Michèle Kiesewetter die? The documentary looks for clues, researches the documents of the investigative committees and examines the evidence. The main protagonist is the ex-police officer Peter F. As a senior detective, he was a member of the “Parkplatz” Soko of the Heilbronn Police Department. Solving the case became a part of his life. Never before has he spoken in front of a television camera about the case that stayed with him for the rest of his life. / Die Polizistin Michèle Kiesewetter wird 2007 am helllichten Tag getotet, mitten in einer GroSSstadt. Klar ist nur der Tathergang: Sie machen Mittagspause in ihrem Streifenwagen, als der 22-jahrigen Polizistin und ihrem Kollegen Martin A. Kugeln in den Kopf geschossen werden. Jahre spater stellt sich heraus, dass die Taten auf das Konto der rechtsextremen Terrororganisation NSU gehen. Neun rassistische Anschlage hatte der NSU zuvor begangen. Dann schieSSen sie auf Polizisten, diesmal nicht aus Rassenhass. Diesmal muss es ein anderes Motiv geben. Aber welches? Warum starb Michèle Kiesewetter?Die Doku geht auf Spurensuche, forscht in den Unterlagen der Untersuchungsausschusse und pruft die Indizien. Hauptprotagonist ist der Ex-Polizist Peter F. Er war als Kriminaloberkommissar Mitglied der Soko "Parkplatz" der Kripo Heilbronn. Die Aufklarung des Falls wurde fur ihn zu einem Lebensinhalt. Nie zuvor hat er vor einer Fernsehkamera uber den Fall gesprochen, der ihn sein Leben lang nicht wieder loslieSS.

programme.title: maischberger / maischberger
programme.desc: Where is the government heading in terms of social reforms, migration and armaments? The parliamentary group leader of the Left, Heidi Reichinnek, and the general secretary of the SPD, Tim Klussendorf, are discussing this. How should Germany and NATO react to drone alarms? In the studio of the military historian Sonke Neitzel RTL/n-tv political director Nikolaus Blome and the head of the parliamentary office of the taz Anna Lehmann. / Wohin steuert die Regierung bei Sozialreformen, Migration und Rustung?Daruber diskutieren die Fraktionsvorsitzende der Linken, Heidi Reichinnek und der Generalsekretar der SPD, Tim Klussendorf.Wie sollen Deutschland und die NATO bei Drohnen-Alarm reagieren?Im Studio der Militarhistoriker Sonke Neitzel.Es kommentieren: der Journalist und Moderator Cherno Jobatey, der RTL/n-tv Politikchef Nikolaus Blome und die Leiterin des Parlamentsburos der taz Anna Lehmann.

programme.title: Hubert without Staller / Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Hubert and Girwidz are on the hunt for a rampaging boar that is making Wolfratshausen unsafe. They stumble across the corpse of forester Ulf Groschel, who was in charge of the wild boars: he was shot backwards! Hubert and Girwidz set out to find the perpetrator. The officials target farmer Xaver Vogl, with whom the dead man had an argument, and the forester's wife, Resi Groschel, who seems to be hiding something. The officers are about to solve the case when they are suddenly shot at from an ambush. Is the perpetrator trying to get Hubert and Girwidz out of the way so as not to get caught? / Hubert und Girwidz sind auf der Jagd nach einem randalierenden Keiler, der Wolfratshausen unsicher macht. Dabei stolpern sie uber die Leiche des Forsters Ulf Groschel, der fur die Wildschweine zustandig war: Er wurde rucklings erschossen! Hubert und Girwidz machen sich auf die Tatersuche. Ins Visier der Beamten geraten Landwirt Xaver Vogl, mit dem der Tote Streit hatte, und die Ehefrau des Forsters, Resi Groschel, die etwas zu verbergen scheint. Die Beamten stehen kurz vor der Aufklarung des Falles, als sie plotzlich aus einem Hinterhalt heraus beschossen werden. Versucht der Tater, Hubert und Girwidz aus dem Weg zu raumen, um nicht uberfuhrt zu werden?

programme.title: Red roses / Rote Rosen
programme.desc: Bella feels misunderstood by everyone - except Victoria. When Svenja and Arthur find out that Elyas did not attack Victoria, she has to admit her intrigue to Bella. But Bella reacts completely differently than expected. Mo, taken by surprise, avoids Julius' marriage proposal. He loves Julius, but first wanted to find out for himself where his career path would take him. But when Mo receives an order for his new company and Julius is overjoyed for him, Mo makes a decision: he makes Julius a counter-proposal! Will this step really change everything? Toni blackmails Valerie by threatening her to tell Noah about the surveillance camera. Valerie has no choice and gives in. However, the video footage has some unexpected surprises that suddenly bring the two sisters closer together. / Bella fuhlt sich von allen unverstanden - auSSer von Victoria. Als Svenja und Arthur herausfinden, dass Elyas Victoria nicht angegriffen hat, muss diese ihre Intrige vor Bella zugeben. Doch Bella reagiert vollig anders als erwartet.Mo weicht Julius Heiratsantrag uberrumpelt aus. Er liebt Julius, mochte aber erst fur sich selbst herausfinden, wohin sein beruflicher Weg ihn fuhrt. Aber als Mo einen Auftrag fur seine neue Firma erhalt und Julius sich uberschwanglich fur ihn freut, trifft Mo eine Entscheidung: Er macht Julius einen Gegenantrag! Wird dieser Schritt wirklich alles verandern?Toni erpresst Valerie, indem sie ihr droht, Noah uber die Überwachungskamera aufzuklaren. Valerie bleibt keine Wahl und sie lenkt ein. Das Videomaterial hat jedoch einige unerwartete Überraschungen parat, die die beiden Schwestern plotzlich naher zusammenbringen.

programme.title: Storm of love / Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: When Alexandra no longer knows what to do next, Markus is dismayed to realize that she is threatening to disappear from his life. This makes him realize that Alexandra has always been his great love. In order not to lose her, Markus makes the greatest possible sacrifice. At Werner's request, Alfons takes a close look at a new employee who tries hard to complete all tasks perfectly and not make any mistakes. While the new colleague offends some people with his overly correct manner, he finds an ally in Fanny. She immediately likes him and defends him from Lale after an incident. Since Lale can no longer stand living under the same roof as Erik, she tells Miro and Greta that she will not move back upstairs to Erik and Yvonne once the fire damage has been repaired. To Miro's delight, Greta also decides to stay with him because she is already used to living with him. / Als Alexandra nicht mehr weiSS, wie es weitergehen soll, erkennt Markus besturzt, dass sie aus seinem Leben zu verschwinden droht. Dadurch wird ihm bewusst, dass Alexandra immer seine groSSe Liebe war. Um sie nicht zu verlieren, bringt Markus das groSStmogliche Opfer.Auf Werners Bitte hin nimmt Alfons einen neuen Angestellten unter die Lupe, der sich groSSe Muhe gibt, alle Aufgaben perfekt zu erfullen und keinen Fehler zu machen. Wahrend der neue Kollege mit seiner uberkorrekten Art bei manchen aneckt, findet er in Fanny eine Verbundete. Sie findet ihn auf Anhieb sympathisch und verteidigt ihn nach einem Zwischenfall vor Lale.Da Lale es nicht mehr aushalt, weiter mit Erik unter einem Dach zu wohnen, teilt sie Miro und Greta mit, dass sie nicht wieder zuruck zu Erik und Yvonne nach oben ziehen wird, wenn der Brandschaden behoben ist. Auch Greta beschlieSSt zu Miros Freude, weiter bei ihm wohnen zu bleiben, denn sie hat sich bereits an das Zusammenleben mit ihm gewohnt.

programme.title: Right in the middle - Frankfurt Airport / Mittendrin - Flughafen Frankfurt
programme.sub-title: 100 Jahre Flughafen - Von den Grunderjahren bis zur Zerstorung
programme.desc: Frankfurt Airport was opened 100 years ago. Its dramatic history between pomp and splendor makes the world airport a mirror of German history. In 1912, the development of aviation reached its first peak at Frankfurter Rebstock, Hesse's first airship port. In 1924, Sudwestdeutsche Luftverkehrs AG was founded. Frankfurt-Rebstock Airport quickly reached its capacity and had to move in 1936. The airships “Graf Zeppelin” and “Hindenburg” begin regular service to Rio de Janeiro and Lakehurst. On July 8th, Lufthansa opened air traffic with a Ju 52. The founding years were marked by fascinating stories, innovations and setbacks. / Vor 100 Jahren wurde der Frankfurter Flughafen eroffnet. Seine dramatische Geschichte zwischen Prunk und Stunk macht den Weltflughafen zu einem Spiegel deutscher Geschichte. 1912 erreicht die Entwicklung der Luftfahrt ihren ersten Hohepunkt am Frankfurter Rebstock, Hessens erstem Luftschiffhafen. 1924 wird die Sudwestdeutsche Luftverkehrs AG gegrundet. Schnell erreicht der Flughafen Frankfurt-Rebstock seine Kapazitaten und muss 1936 umziehen. Die Luftschiffe "Graf Zeppelin" und "Hindenburg" nehmen den Linienverkehr nach Rio de Janeiro und Lakehurst auf. Am 8. Juli eroffnet die Lufthansa den Flugverkehr mit einer Ju 52. Die Grunderjahre waren gepragt von faszinierenden Geschichten, Innovationen und Ruckschlagen.

programme.title: In all friendship - The young doctors / In aller Freundschaft - Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: The actor Burkhard Kreisel has severe pain in his abdomen and shortness of breath. Because Dr. When Ben Ahlbeck and Sofia Galura have to insert a catheter, Sofia asks for his emergency contact. But Burkhard lives for the stage. Because of this, his marriage broke up and now he is alone. He can only name his daughter Paula Kreisel, whom he hasn't seen for years. He is all the more surprised when she shows up at the Johannes Thal Clinic. Despite all the family conflicts, it becomes clear that there is one thing that connects daughter and father: acting. But when Burkhard finds out that Paula wants to follow in his footsteps, he doesn't seem to be happy about it at all, and his relationship with Paula suffers another break... Donnie Gauss slipped in the shower and broke his arm. When assistant doctor Oliver Probst takes the man in, he is amazed when he turns out to be Dr. Julia Berger's new boyfriend turns out. The treatment becomes even more unpleasant for Olli when the suspicion arises that Donnie is not just driving on two tracks - but on multiple tracks. He trusts Dr. Marc Lindner, but neither of them suspects that Julia has a completely different problem. While Prof. Dr. As Karin Patzelt tries to find out who her stubborn admirer is, who showers her with gifts, the interns in urology have to assert themselves. Dr. Rolf Kaminski from the Saxony Clinic was brought to the JTK by Ben Ahlbeck to take over the urology consultation and give the interns an insight into the subject. Olli, Sofia and Tamar are initially not impressed with Kaminski's style and his field of expertise. And when they went through the anamnesis incompletely, it became clear: they had to think about something, otherwise it would be unpleasant! / Der Schauspieler Burkhard Kreisel hat starke Schmerzen im Unterleib und Luftnot. Da Dr. Ben Ahlbeck und Sofia Galura einen Katheter legen mussen, erkundigt sich Sofia nach seinem Notfallkontakt. Doch Burkhard lebt fur die Buhne. Daruber ist seine Ehe zerbrochen und nun ist er allein. Nur Tochter Paula Kreisel kann er angeben, die er seit Jahren nicht gesehen hat. Umso uberraschter ist er, als sie im Johannes-Thal-Klinikum auftaucht. Trotz aller familiaren Konflikte wird klar, dass es eine Sache gibt, die Tochter und Vater verbindet: das Schauspielen. Doch als Burkhard erfahrt, dass Paula in seine FuSSstapfen treten will, scheint er daruber ganz und gar nicht glucklich zu sein, und die Beziehung zu Paula erleidet einen erneuten Bruch ...Donnie Gauss ist in der Dusche ausgerutscht und hat sich dabei einen Arm gebrochen. Als Assistenzarzt Oliver Probst den Mann aufnimmt, staunt er nicht schlecht, als dieser sich als Dr. Julia Bergers neuer Freund entpuppt. Fur Olli wird die Behandlung noch unangenehmer, als der Verdacht aufkommt, dass Donnie nicht nur zweigleisig - sondern mehrgleisig - fahrt. Er vertraut sich Dr. Marc Lindner an, doch beide ahnen nicht, dass Julia ein ganz anderes Problem hat.Wahrend Prof. Dr. Karin Patzelt herauszufinden versucht, wer ihr hartnackiger Verehrer ist, der sie mit Geschenken uberhauft, mussen sich die Assistenzarzte in der Urologie behaupten. Dr. Rolf Kaminski aus der Sachsen-Klinik wurde von Ben Ahlbeck ans JTK geholt, um die Urologie-Sprechstunde zu ubernehmen und den Assistenzarzten einen Einblick in das Fach zu verschaffen. Olli, Sofia und Tamar sind von Kaminskis Art und seiner Fachrichtung zunachst nicht angetan. Und als sie Anamnesen luckenhaft durchfuhren, wird klar: Sie mussen sich etwas uberlegen, sonst wird es unangenehm!

programme.title: The Vienna crime thriller: Blindly investigated - Death in the Tiergarten / Der Wien-Krimi: Blind ermittelt - Tod im Tiergarten
programme.desc: A restless night in Vienna's Tiergarten: unusual noises and loud animal cries. In the morning, the night watchman Gustl Klingenberger (Christoph Luser) finds a man's corpse on Monkey Island: no traces, no witnesses, no one in the zoo knows him! Inspector Peter Lassmann (Michael Edlinger), who is leading a murder investigation for the first time, asks special investigator Alexander Haller (Philipp Hochmair) and his partner Niko Falk (Andreas Guenther) for support - especially since Lassmann is having a hard time with the new chief inspector Mia Markovic (Claudia Kottal). The first trace leads to the "Furry" scene, which celebrates exuberantly in Markus Bohm's (Leo Reisinger) exclusive club in fantasy animal costumes as an evil wolf, colorful cat or mysterious little sheep. Who has what with whom comes into focus, as does the difficult marriage of the dead man, who turns out to be a nocturnal tax advisor. While the special investigators uncover his secrets, Markovic concentrates on solving a mysterious robbery-murder. When she comes to the connecting piece between the traps, Haller and Falk also find the right trail, but it leads both of them into great danger. / Eine unruhige Nacht im Wiener Tiergarten: ungewohnte Gerausche und laute Tierschreie. Am Morgen findet der Nachtwarter Gustl Klingenberger (Christoph Luser) auf der Affeninsel eine Mannerleiche: keine Spuren, keine Zeugen, keiner im Tiergarten kennt ihn! Kommissar Peter Lassmann (Michael Edlinger), der zum ersten Mal eine Mordermittlung leitet, bittet Sonderermittler Alexander Haller (Philipp Hochmair) und dessen Partner Niko Falk (Andreas Guenther) um Unterstutzung - zumal sich Lassmann mit der neuen Hauptkommissarin Mia Markovic (Claudia Kottal) schwertut. Eine erste Spur fuhrt in die "Furry"-Szene, die in dem exklusiven Club von Markus Bohm (Leo Reisinger) in Fantasy-Tierkostumen als boser Wolf, bunte Katze oder geheimnisvolles Schafchen ausgelassen feiert. Wer was mit wem hat, kommt ebenso in den Fokus wie die schwierige Ehe des Toten, der sich als nachtaktiver Steuerberater herausstellt. Wahrend die Sonderermittler seinen Geheimnissen auf die Schliche kommen, konzentriert sich Markovic darauf, einen ratselhaften Raubmord aufzuklaren. Als sie auf das Verbindungsstuck zwischen den Fallen kommt, finden auch Haller und Falk die richtige Spur, die beide jedoch in groSSte Gefahr fuhrt.
