programme.title: Dark Windows / Dark Windows
programme.desc: A group of young friends mourn an accidental death in their ranks that was their own fault. A weekend in the countryside is supposed to bring distraction, but turns into a horror trip. In their remote holiday home, the trio is terrorized by an unknown person in a ghostly way with memories of their fateful night together. The friends soon have to fight for their survival when the masked stranger hunts them down. Tilly (Anna Bullard), Monica (Annie Hamilton) and Peter (Rory Alexander) recently lost their friend Ali (Grace Binford Sheene) in a car accident that was their fault. After the funeral service, at which there is hostility from Ali's uncle Bob (Morten Holst), Monica suggests that Tilly and Peter take a break in the uninhabited country house of her deceased grandparents. Ali's death remains the dominant theme there, too, with the trio trying to come to terms with the loss in different ways. While the guilt-ridden Tilly can't let go and takes antidepressants, Monica tries to suppress things and look forward. Peter, on the other hand, struggles with his alcohol addiction, which he denies. When the signs increase that something is wrong in their holiday home, the friends' grief suddenly fades into the background. It quickly becomes clear: They are not alone there and have to fear for their lives. The Norwegian horror thriller "Dark Windows" places a comparatively large focus on creating an emotional foundation for its plot, which subsequently develops eerily into the breeding ground for the film's horror moments. In order to give his film an American cinema look, director Alex Herron shot in English as well as an international one Cast - including German actress Anna Bullard ("Spides", "SOKO Stuttgart") in one of the main roles. / Eine Gruppe junger Freunde betrauert einen von ihnen selbst verschuldeten Unfalltod in ihren Reihen. Ein Wochenende im Grunen soll Ablenkung bringen, wird jedoch zum Horrortrip.In ihrem abgelegenen Ferienhaus wird das Trio von einem Unbekannten auf gespenstische Weise mit Erinnerungen an ihre gemeinsame Schicksalsnacht terrorisiert. Bald schon mussen die Freunde um ihr Überleben kampfen, als der maskierte Fremde Jagd auf sie macht.Tilly (Anna Bullard), Monica (Annie Hamilton) und Peter (Rory Alexander) haben kurzlich bei einem von ihnen verschuldeten Autounfall ihre Freundin Ali (Grace Binford Sheene) verloren. Nach der Trauerfeier, bei der es zu Anfeindungen seitens Alis Onkel Bob (Morten Holst) kommt, schlagt Monica Tilly und Peter eine Auszeit im unbewohnten Landhaus ihrer verstorbenen GroSSeltern vor.Alis Tod bleibt auch dort das bestimmende Thema, wobei das Trio auf unterschiedliche Weise versucht, mit dem Verlust klarzukommen. Wahrend die schuldgeplagte Tilly nicht loslassen kann und Antidepressiva einnimmt, versucht Monica, zu verdrangen und nach vorne zu blicken. Peter kampft hingegen mit seiner von ihm verleugneten Alkoholsucht.Als sich die Anzeichen mehren, dass etwas in ihrem Ferienhaus nicht stimmt, ruckt die Trauer der Freunde jedoch schlagartig in den Hintergrund. Schnell wird klar: Sie sind dort nicht allein und mussen um ihr Leben furchten.Der norwegische Horrorthriller "Dark Windows" legt einen vergleichsweise groSSen Fokus darauf, ein emotionales Fundament fur seine Handlung zu entwerfen, das sich in der Folge gespenstisch zum Nahrboden fur die Schreckensmomente des Films entwickelt.Um seinem Film einen amerikanischen Kino-Look zu verpassen, drehte Regisseur Alex Herron in Englisch sowie mit einem internationalen Cast - darunter in einer der Hauptrollen die deutsche Schauspielerin Anna Bullard ("Spides", "SOKO Stuttgart").

programme.title: Hell / Hell
programme.desc: After a strong warming of the earth's atmosphere, the world has degenerated into a wasteland. The couple Marie and Phillip fight for survival together with Marie's young sister Leonie. In Tom, the trio gains a new comrade-in-arms before the group is separated from each other in a conflict with strangers. Marie finds help from a farmer, but her new refuge has nasty surprises in store for her. In the near future, the earth has degenerated into a wasteland and the sun has become an enemy. Marie (Hannah Herzsprung), her teenage sister Leonie (Lisa Vicari) and her boyfriend Phillip (Lars Eidinger) make a living as nomads in an old car. At an abandoned gas station, to the women's chagrin, Phillip takes in the thief Tom (Stipe Erceg), who knows how to deal with cars and has stashed gasoline. The group sets off to a possible water source in the mountains. On their journey, they come across a crashed car that turns out to be a trap: while the adults are examining the destroyed vehicle, Leonie and the group's car are kidnapped by strangers. Marie, Phillip and Tom locate the camp of their attackers, but their attempt to free them goes wrong. Marie is left alone and without a trace of Leonie. When she meets a local farmer (Angela Winkler), Marie gains new hope, but her helper and her family turn out to be part of the kidnappers who are hiding a dark secret. With the dystopian horror thriller "Hell", the Munich-trained Swiss filmmaker Tim Fehlbaum celebrated his cinematic debut in 2011, for which he received, among other things, the German Hollywood director Roland Emmerich was able to win as executive producer and advisor. However, Fehlbaum did not follow Emmerich's advice to shoot the film in English to increase its chances of international success. Instead, the director was able to secure commitments from established German acting stars Hannah Herzsprung, Lars Eidinger and Stipe Erceg and, with "Hell", demonstrated that genre cinema is also in demand in Germany as a production location. / Nach einer starken Erwarmung der Erdatmosphare ist die Welt zur Einode verkommen. Das Paar Marie und Phillip kampft gemeinsam mit Maries junger Schwester Leonie ums Überleben.Mit Tom gewinnt das Trio einen neuen Mitstreiter, bevor die Gruppe bei einem Konflikt mit Fremden voneinander getrennt wird. Marie findet Hilfe bei einer Bauerin, doch ihre neue Zuflucht halt bose Überraschungen fur sie bereit.In der nahen Zukunft ist die Erde zu einer Einode verkommen und die Sonne zum Feind geworden. Marie (Hannah Herzsprung), ihre jugendliche Schwester Leonie (Lisa Vicari) und ihr Freund Phillip (Lars Eidinger) schlagen sich in einem alten Wagen als Nomaden durch.An einer verlassenen Tankstelle nimmt Phillip zum Verdruss der Frauen den Dieb Tom (Stipe Erceg) auf, der sich auf Autos versteht und Benzin gebunkert hat. Die Gruppe macht sich auf zu einem moglichen Wasservorkommen in den Bergen.Auf ihrer Reise stoSSen sie auf ein verunglucktes Auto, das sich als Falle erweist: Denn wahrend die Erwachsenen das zerstorte Fahrzeug mustern, werden Leonie und der Wagen der Gruppe von Fremden verschleppt.Marie, Phillip und Tom machen das Lager ihrer Angreifer ausfindig, jedoch lauft ihr Befreiungsversuch schief. Marie bleibt alleine und ohne eine Spur von Leonie zuruck. Als sie eine ortskundige Bauerin (Angela Winkler) trifft, schopft Marie neue Hoffnung, doch ihre Helferin und deren Familie entpuppen sich als Teil der Entfuhrer, die ein finsteres Geheimnis verbergen.Mit dem dystopischen Horror-Thriller "Hell" feierte der in Munchen ausgebildete Schweizer Filmemacher Tim Fehlbaum 2011 sein Kino-Debut, fur das er unter anderem den deutschen Hollywood-Regisseur Roland Emmerich als Executive Producer und Ratgeber gewinnen konnte.Den Rat Emmerichs, den Film zur Erhohung seiner internationalen Erfolgschancen in Englisch zu drehen, befolgte Fehlbaum allerdings nicht. Stattdessen konnte sich der Regisseur Zusagen der etablierten deutschen Schauspielstars Hannah Herzsprung, Lars Eidinger und Stipe Erceg sichern und mit "Hell" so unter Beweis stellen, das Genre-Kino auch am Produktionsstandort Deutschland gefragt ist.

programme.title: The Owners / The Owners
programme.desc: Together with two friends, Nathan wants to break into a remote country house to empty out a large safe. But his pregnant girlfriend Mary doesn't have a good feeling about it. The safe won't open, and when the older couple returns, the situation gets out of control. The homeowners do not behave as one would expect from defenseless hostages. Apparently they have something to hide.Nathan (Ian Kenny) has a plan. Together with his friends Gaz (Jake Curran) and Terry (Andrew Ellis) he wants to break into a secluded country house. The trio expects a lucrative loot because they have learned that there is a large safe in the house. While they wait for the owners to leave the house, Nathan's girlfriend Mary (Maisie Williams) unexpectedly shows up and is not enthusiastic about the idea. In fact, there are problems because the trio are unable to open the safe before Dr. Huggins (Sylvester McCoy) and his wife Ellen (Rita Tushingham) return. Mary, who has now told her boyfriend that she is pregnant, wanted to cancel the whole thing. Terry is no longer convinced by the plan either. But the situation takes an unexpected turn. Although Nathan and Gaz resort to increasingly brutal measures, the older, inconspicuous couple hardly appears intimidated and refuses to reveal the combination of numbers. It slowly becomes apparent that Richard and Ellen Huggins are keeping a dark secret of their own. The atmospheric home invasion thriller is based on the graphic novel "Une nuit de pleine lune" by comic author Hermann. One of the Belgian's best-known works is the dystopian series "Jeremiah", the first part of which was published in 1979. A total of 40 episodes have been released by 2023, a majority of which have been implemented as a television series with Luke Perry in the lead role. Hermann worked with his son Yves H. on many of his books, including the original for "The Owners." Maisie Williams achieved her international breakthrough with her first role. At the age of twelve, the British actress was cast as Arya Stark in the hit series "Game of Thrones." / Gemeinsam mit zwei Freunden will Nathan in ein abgelegenes Landhaus einbrechen, um dort einen groSSen Safe auszuraumen. Doch seine schwangere Freundin Mary hat gar kein gutes Gefuhl bei der Sache.Der Tresor lasst sich nicht offnen, und als das altere Ehepaar zuruckkehrt, gerat die Situation auSSer Kontrolle. Die Hausbesitzer verhalten sich namlich nicht so, wie man es von wehrlosen Geiseln erwarten wurde. Offensichtlich haben sie etwas zu verheimlichen.Nathan (Ian Kenny) hat einen Plan. Gemeinsam mit seinen Freunden Gaz (Jake Curran) und Terry (Andrew Ellis) will er in ein abgeschiedenes Landhaus einbrechen. Das Trio verspricht sich eine lukrative Beute, denn sie haben erfahren, dass im Haus ein groSSer Safe vorhanden ist. Wahrend sie warten, bis die Besitzer das Haus verlassen, taucht unerwartet Nathans Freundin Mary (Maisie Williams) auf, die von der Idee nicht begeistert ist.Tatsachlich gibt es Probleme, denn dem Trio gelingt es nicht, den Tresor zu offnen, bevor Dr. Huggins (Sylvester McCoy) und seine Frau Ellen (Rita Tushingham) zuruckkehren. Mary, die ihrem Freund mittlerweile mitgeteilt hat, dass sie schwanger ist, mochte die ganze Aktion am liebsten abbrechen. Auch Terry ist von dem Plan nicht mehr uberzeugt.Doch die Situation nimmt eine unerwartete Wendung. Obwohl Nathan und Gaz zu immer brutaleren MaSSnahmen greifen, zeigt sich das altere, unscheinbare Ehepaar kaum eingeschuchtert und weigert sich, die Zahlenkombination preiszugeben. Langsam offenbart sich, dass Richard und Ellen Huggins selbst ein dusteres Geheimnis bewahren.Der atmospharische Home-Invasion-Thriller basiert auf der Graphic Novel "Une nuit de pleine lune" des Comicautors Hermann. Zu den bekanntesten Werken des Belgiers gehort die dystopische Reihe "Jeremiah", deren erster Teil 1979 erschien. Bis 2023 wurden insgesamt 40 Folgen veroffentlicht, von denen ein GroSSteil als Fernsehserie mit Luke Perry in der Hauptrolle umgesetzt wurde. Bei vielen seiner Bucher arbeitete Hermann mit seinem Sohn Yves H. zusammen, so auch bei der Vorlage zu "The Owners".Bereits mit ihrer ersten Rolle gelang Maisie Williams der internationale Durchbruch. Im Alter von zwolf Jahren wurde die britische Schauspielerin als Arya Stark in der Erfolgsserie "Game of Thrones" besetzt.

programme.title: Emergency call harbor edge / Notruf Hafenkante
programme.desc: Franzi testifies in court as a witness in a rape case and is dismayed to discover that her husband Philipp, of all people, is questioning the victim's credibility. The two of them are already in a serious marital crisis. Because Franzi has every reason to believe that Philipp was cheating on her. He has had close contact with the lawyer Nicole Fink for a long time, and Franzi believes that the two see each other in more than just a professional capacity. Months ago, Franzi found Julia Schneider, who had been raped, during an operation, accompanied her to the EKH and filed a complaint with her against the chef Jacques Messmer. In court, Messmer's lawyer, Nicole Fink, pursues a clear strategy: There was sexual contact between Messmer and Julia Schneider - with mutual consent. Fink also questions Franzi's integrity during her interrogation. Irritated because the attack feels personal, Franzi maintains her professionalism for the time being. But Philipp's appearance in court throws her off course. He attests that Julia Schneider has an unstable, nymphomaniac personality. Then he also denies that he and Nicole Fink know each other personally. In Franzi's eyes, however, he has drawn up a report of favor for the defense, and her suspicion that he was cheating on her is also confirmed. / Franzi sagt vor Gericht als Zeugin in einem Vergewaltigungsfall aus und muss besturzt feststellen, dass die Glaubwurdigkeit des Opfers ausgerechnet von ihrem Mann Philipp angezweifelt wird.Die beiden stecken ohnehin in einer handfesten Ehekrise. Denn Franzi hat allen Grund zu der Annahme, dass Philipp sie betrugt. Schon seit Langem hat er engen Kontakt zu der Anwaltin Nicole Fink, und Franzi glaubt, dass die beiden sich nicht nur beruflich sehen.Vor Monaten hatte Franzi bei einem Einsatz die vergewaltigte Julia Schneider aufgefunden, zum EKH begleitet und mit ihr die Anzeige gegen den Koch Jacques Messmer aufgenommen. Vor Gericht verfolgt die Anwaltin von Messmer, Nicole Fink, eine klare Strategie: Es gab sexuellen Kontakt zwischen Messmer und Julia Schneider - in gegenseitigem Einvernehmen.Fink stellt in ihrer Vernehmung auch Franzis Integritat infrage. Irritiert, weil sich der Angriff personlich anfuhlt, behalt Franzi jedoch vorerst ihre Professionalitat. Doch Philipps Auftauchen vor Gericht wirft sie aus der Bahn. Er attestiert Julia Schneider eine labile, nymphomane Personlichkeit. Dann streitet er auch noch ab, dass er und Nicole Fink sich personlich kennen. In Franzis Augen aber hat er ein Gefalligkeitsgutachten fur die Verteidigung erstellt, und auch ihr Verdacht, dass er sie betrugt, erhartet sich.

programme.title: SOKE / SOKO Wismar
programme.desc: A man who seems to have fallen out of time lies dead in a street. Apart from a key, the SOKO only finds a box of matches on him, which leads them directly to the Engel inn. The inspectors question the inn owner, Doris Engel. It turns out that the dead man is her son Frank Engel. A few days ago he was released from a prison in Indonesia for 18 years and returned to Wismar. His former best friend and then drug dealer Eddi Nagelstedt is responsible for Frank's arrest in Indonesia: Eddi had lent Frank his backpack and allegedly forgot the drugs in it. Frank was then arrested at the airport and was never able to prove his innocence. Did Frank go to Eddi's after his return home to confront him with the facts? Heinze's neighbors also report a heated argument between Frank and his father Karl. Did their argument possibly escalate in the end? When the investigators discover a blanket with dried blood in the back of Karl's pickup truck, he finds himself in need of explanation. / Ein wie aus der Zeit gefallener Mann liegt tot in einer StraSSe. Die SOKO findet auSSer einem Schlussel nur noch eine Streichholzschachtel bei ihm, die sie direkt zum Gasthof Engel fuhrt.Die Kommissare befragen die Gasthofbesitzerin Doris Engel. Wie sich herausstellt, ist der Tote ihr Sohn Frank Engel. Er war vor einigen Tagen aus einer 18-jahrigen Haft aus einem Gefangnis in Indonesien entlassen worden und nach Wismar zuruckgekehrt.Fur Franks Verhaftung in Indonesien ist ausgerechnet sein fruherer bester Freund und damaliger Drogendealer Eddi Nagelstedt verantwortlich: Eddi hatte Frank seinen Rucksack geliehen und die Drogen darin angeblich vergessen. Am Flughafen wurde Frank daraufhin verhaftet, seine Unschuld konnte er nie beweisen. War Frank nach seiner Heimkehr zu Eddi gefahren, um ihn mit den Tatsachen zu konfrontieren?Die Nachbarn Heinze berichten auSSerdem von einem heftigen Streit zwischen Frank und seinem Vater Karl. Ist ihr Streit am Ende womoglich eskaliert?Als die Ermittler eine Decke mit eingetrocknetem Blut auf der Ladeflache von Karls Pick-up entdecken, gerat er in Erklarungsnot.

programme.title: Die Rosenheim-Cops / Die Rosenheim-Cops
programme.desc: Thomas Sailer is found dead in his pawn shop in the morning. A valuable painting was stolen. The suspect is Franz von Stein, who had previously had an argument with the victim. When the stolen picture turns up, the nobleman comes under increasing pressure. But it turns out that the painting is a fake. Now the cops believe that the real work of art will also lead them to the real murderer. And at the police station, Ms. Ortmann assumes that Secretary Stockl is once again using her time on duty for private errands. The controller has no idea that Police Chief Achtziger is ultimately behind the tasks. / Thomas Sailer wird morgens erschlagen in seinem Pfandleihhaus aufgefunden. Doch es stellt sich heraus, dass es sich bei dem Gemalde um eine Falschung handelt. Nun glauben die Cops, dass das wahre Kunstwerk sie auch zum wahren Morder fuhrt.Und im Kommissariat geht Frau Ortmann davon aus, dass Sekretarin Stockl ihre Dienstzeit mal wieder fur private Besorgungen nutzt. programme.title: Soko Vienna / SOKO Wien
programme.desc: Lukas Brandt lies shot to death in a warehouse. Together with his brother Jan and mother Ulli, he was part of a petty criminal family gang. To the outside world, they appear as bar owners who are in the process of getting their bar into shape. In fact, they earn their money through burglaries of all kinds. In Gokhan Kaya's pawn shop they get rid of their stolen goods, most recently jewelry from a notorious jeweler. His shop is considered a hub for money laundering by the Kogler gang, led by Colin, whose father and actual boss is currently sitting. Colin's brother paid for his intervention in Brandt's jewelry store break-in by losing an eye. Reason enough to punish Lukas for this? An alibi is claimed, and the question arises as to which perpetrator knew where Lukas was and when. The warehouse seemed to be a meeting place with his dealer, as evidenced by telltale puncture marks and the ecstasy he consumed shortly before his death. The fact that Luka's six-year-old niece Mia, who lives with her mother, "nibbled" one of the colorful pills while visiting her father Jan and had to go to the hospital, gives the research a new dimension. Just like the fact that fence Gokhan was duped by the Brandt brothers. / Lukas Brandt liegt erschossen in einer Lagerhalle. Zusammen mit seinem Bruder Jan und Mutter Ulli war er Teil einer kleinkriminellen Familienbande.Nach auSSen treten sie als Lokalbesitzer auf, die dabei sind, ihre Kneipe auf Vordermann zu bringen. Tatsachlich verdienen sie ihr Geld mit Einbruchen jeglicher Art. In Gokhan Kayas Pfandleihe werden sie ihr Diebesgut los, zuletzt Schmuck eines beruchtigten Juweliers.Sein Geschaft gilt als Umschlageplatz fur Geldwasche der Kogler-Bande, angefuhrt von Colin, dessen Vater und eigentlicher Chef gerade sitzt. Colins Bruder buSSte sein Einschreiten bei Brandts Einbruch im Schmuckladen mit dem Verlust eines Auges. Grund genug, Lukas dafur zu bestrafen? Ein Alibi wird behauptet, und es steht die Frage im Raum, welcher Tater gewusst hat, wo sich Lukas wann aufhalten wurde. Das Lagerhaus schien Treffpunkt mit seinem Dealer zu sein, was verraterische Einstichstellen und das kurz vor seinem Tod konsumierte Ecstasy dokumentieren.Dass auch Lukas sechsjahrige, bei ihrer Mutter lebende Nichte Mia bei ihrem Besuch bei Vater Jan eine der bunten Pillen "naschte" und ins Krankenhaus musste, verleiht den Recherchen eine neue Dimension. Genauso, wie die Tatsache, dass Hehler Gokhan von den Brandt-Brudern ubers Ohr gehauen wurde.

programme.title: Motorsports: Extreme E 2025 / Motorsports: Extreme E 2025
programme.desc: Desert x Prix (2nd race). Electric driving reaches some of the most secluded corners of the planet to emphasize the consequences of climate change facing different ecosystems, while also showing the performance of electric SUVs in extreme conditions. Description: Christos Kyriazis. / Desert X Prix (2ος Αγώνας). Η ηλεκτρική οδήγηση φτάνει σε μερικές από τις πιο απομονωμένες γωνιές του πλανήτη για να τονίσει τις συνέπειες της κλιματικής αλλαγής που αντιμετωπίζουν τα διαφορετικά οικοσυστήματα, ενώ συνάμα παρουσιάζει την απόδοση ηλεκτρικών SUV σε ακραίες συνθήκες. Περιγραφή: Χρήστος Κυριαζής.

programme.desc: In the beginning, medicine was magical. The darkness of the night was feared, nature was venerated. Illness was a punishment from the Gods, and only a few had the power to heal. programme.desc: A journey to discover the immaculate landscapes and unique biodiversity of the Camargue nature reserve. Located on the edge of the Rhone delta, where fresh and salt water meet, the documentary series offers us in 2 episodes a rare glimpse of little-known marine species. / Uma viagem à descoberta das paisagens imaculadas e da biodiversidade única da reserva natural de Camargue. Localizada na orla do delta do Rodano, onde a água doce e a salgada se encontram, a serie documental oferece-nos em 2 episodios um raro vislumbre de especies marinhas pouco conhecidas.

programme.title: Ziggy and the Zootram / Ziggy and the Zootram
programme.desc: Ziggy is a friendly freshwater crocodile from Australia. He and his friends live in their eccentric houses located in a crater on an island. Ziggy and his friends have a very special secret - besides walking like people, talking like people - they all work in a zoo! / Ziggy e um simpático crocodilo-de-água-doce da Austrália. Ele e os seus amigos vivem nas suas excentricas casas situadas numa cratera de uma ilha. Ziggy e os seus amigos tem um segredo muito especial - alem de andarem como gente, falarem como gente - todos trabalham num jardim zoologico!

programme.desc: In Broom, a small village with a strong rescue team, there are always accidents and problems such as a car crashing into a ravine on a rainy day, a child locked in a house, among other dangerous situations. In each episode, the village's rescue team saves some of the inhabitants. / Em Broom, uma pequena vila com uma forte equipa de resgate, existem sempre acidentes e problemas como um carro que se despista numa ravina num dia de chuva, uma criança fechada numa casa, entre outras situações de perigo. Em cada episodio, a equipa de resgate da vila salva alguns dos habitantes.

It celebrates the realities, learning and adventure of being a preschooler when life is full of everyday dramas for both children and adults. / Bing Bunny e uma serie baseada nos livros infantis do autor e ilustrador Ted Dewan. Celebra as realidades, a aprendizagem e a aventura de ser uma criança do pre-escolar quando a vida está repleta de dramas quotidianos, tanto para as crianças como para os adultos.

programme.desc: The Lemmings scribble all over the “Snow White” book on the living room sofa. Grizzy throws them out with little ceremony and they fall to the ground with their book, which opens to the page where the dwarves are working in the mines with pickaxes. The shock of the fall causes a personality disorder. / Os Lemingues rabiscam por todo o livro de «A Branca De Neve» no sofá da sala. Grizzy expulsa-os com pouca cerimonia e eles caem ao chao com o seu livro, que se abre na página onde os anões estao a trabalhar nas minas com picaretas. O choque da queda provoca um distúrbio de personalidade.

programme.desc: Every morning, Nuno and Malika leave home 30 minutes early to go to school and they still arrive late every morning! But even though their stories are always true, the school principal never believes them... / Todas as manhas, Nuno e Malika saem de casa 30 minutos mais cedo para ir à escola e ainda assim todas as manhas chegam atrasados! Isto porque todas as manhas, algo incrível acontece no caminho. Mas mesmo que as suas historias sejam sempre verdadeiras, a diretora da escola nunca acredita nelas...

programme.title: Front Line / Linha da Frente
programme.desc: It's 10 pm and Bairro Alto is transformed into a street market. Bars compete with each other to see who sells the most alcohol, challenging the limits of whoever passes by. programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: Niggemann Vs Sow / Borilački sport - MMA: Niggemann vs Sow
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: MMA UFC Fight Night / MMA UFC Fight Night
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Hapeel Tel Aviv - Maccabi Tel Aviv / Košarka - Euroleague: Hapeol Tel Aviv - Maccabi Tel Aviv
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Crvena Zvezda - Zadar / Košarka - ABA liga: Crvena zvezda - Zadar
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - FIBA ​​Champions League: Galatasaray - Igokea / Košarka - FIBA Liga šampiona: Galatasaray - Igokea
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba Basketball Champions League. The aim of this league to compete with the Organization of Euroleague Basketball S.L. And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The system of competition consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the end tournament of the best four or popularly called Fajbal for. The finish is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina Basketball Champions League. Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji Euroleague Basketball S.L. i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajbal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Basketball - Eurocup: Hapoel Jerusalem - Cedevita Olympia / Košarka - Eurocup: Hapoel Jerusalem - Cedevita Olimpija
programme.desc: EUROPUP CASTED 2002. years as a second competition of Euroleague Basketball. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to elect placement in the Euroleague are struggling in this competition, and in it, they participate mainly clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues. programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Partizan - Krka / Košarka - ABA liga: Partizan - Krka
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Rudar - Borac / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Rudar - Borac
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Mothers champions / Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

They experience both happy and less happy moments in the new environment, from births, celebrations, to fires, and they have to face the fact that it is not so easy to create a stable home as it looks at first glance. / Charles se z ženo in hčerkami preseli v Kansas. Bujna indijanska pokrajina mu že med potjo postane všeč. Z ženo in tremi hčerami se hitro ustalijo.V novem okolju doživljajo tako srečne kot manj srečne trenutke, od rojstev, praznovanj, do požarov, soočiti pa se morajo predvsem z dejstvom, da si ni tako lahko ustvariti stabilen dom kot izgleda na prvi pogled.

programme.desc: The capsule show features the latest fashion trends for young people and young people at heart. programme.title: Chat by coffee / Klepet ob kavi
programme.desc: Open the treasure trove of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer surrenders together with interesting guests on the show Chat Ob coffee. In each show, they address several topical topics that relate to health, personal growth and spirituality. The creators of the show are at the same time researchers who devote themselves to both old wisdom and contemporary approaches. They believe in good stories and exceptional people, so in each show we will be able to listen to interesting personalities and their experience and life stories. / Odprite zakladnico zanimivih zamisli, idej in informacij, ki jih Jasmina Kandorfer predaja skupaj z zanimivimi gosti v oddaji Klepet ob kavi. V vsaki oddaji obravnavajo več aktualnih tematik, ki se navezujejo na zdravje, osebnostno rast in duhovnost. Ustvarjalci oddaje so hkrati raziskovalci, ki se posvečajo tako starim modrostim kot sodobnim pristopom. Verjamejo v dobre zgodbe in izjemne ljudi, zato bomo v vsaki oddaji lahko prisluhnili zanimivim osebnostim ter njihovim izkušnjam in življenjskim zgodbam.

programme.title: How did Earth shape us: fire / Kako nas je Zemlja oblikovala: Ogenj

programme.title: Container wars: fresh blood / Kontejnerske vojne: Sveža kri
programme.desc: A brand new series of "container war" proves that a good balance in the bank account does not yet guarantee success in the world of port auctions, in which everything is happening at a flash pace. In this game of high inserts, to overcome opponents who also want to enrich, it also requires a good nose for mild and steel nerves. Because these are large sums of money, this is not a game, but a real war. Meet John Kunkl's auctions and auction participants who are fighting for the best bargains, including Jason R. Hughes and Matthew Gaus. Who will be out of the "container wars" as a winner? / Povsem nova serija "Kontejnerske vojne" dokazuje, da dobro stanje na bančnem računu še ne zagotavlja uspeha v svetu pristaniških dražb, v katerem se vse dogaja z bliskovitim tempom. V tej igri visokih vložkov sta za premagovanje nasprotnikov, ki si prav tako želijo obogateti, potrebna tudi dober nos za blago in jekleni živci. Ker gre za velike vsote denarja, to ni nikakršna igra, pač pa prava vojna. Spoznajte dražbarja Johna Kunkla in udeležence dražb, ki se med seboj borijo za najboljše kupčije, med katerimi sta tudi Jason R. Hughes in Matthew Gaus. Kdo bo iz "Kontejnerskih vojn" izšel kot zmagovalec?

programme.desc: Dog education expert and presenter Graeme Hall strives to restore harmony and, with more than 10 years of experience, gained a reputation by finding quick but long -lasting solutions for almost all problems related to dog behavior. programme.desc: The Euro was created in 2002 as the second "Euroleague Basketball" competition. Uvrstitev v Evrokup si klubi zagotovijo preko nacionalnih prvenstev in pokalov ter preko povabil, t.i. "wildcards".

programme.title: Football (M): B. Leverkusen - Union Berlin, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): B. Leverkusen - Union Berlin, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: World: Brian Wilson - a boy from the beach who changed the direction of popular music, Mon. / Svetovno: Brian Wilson – deček s plaže, ki je spremenil smer popularne glasbe, pon.
programme.desc: When mentioning American dreams, many people probably immediately think of carefree walking under the scorching sun. At these enjoyable frequencies, Brian Wilson also searched for the perfect pop tune. The Beach Boys group was singing everything on idyllic postcards from this US state: the sun, the sea, the high waves and the carved surfers, the lack of dressed girls, the wild racing with the convertible… and then? In the spring of 1966, the band The Beach Boys released the album PET SOUNDS and changed the direction of popular music. More specifically: In the spring of 1966, Brian Wilson released five Sounds under the brand The Beach Boys and hinted at changes in popular music. With him, rock music also became an intimate and spiritual experience, and not just a carefree dance party. He was quoted every step of the way. / Ob omembi ameriških sanj verjetno marsikdo takoj pomisli na brezskrbno pohajkovanje pod žgočim kalifornijskim soncem. Ob teh uživaških frekvencah je popolno pop melodijo sprva iskal tudi Brian Wilson. Skupina The Beach Boys je namreč opevala vse, kar si na idiličnih razglednicah iz te ameriške zvezne države predstavljamo: sonce, morje, visoke valove in na njih izklesane deskarje, pomanjkljivo oblečena dekleta, divje dirkanje s kabrioleti … In potem? Spomladi leta 1966 je skupina The Beach Boys izdala album Pet Sounds in spremenila smer popularne glasbe. Točneje: spomladi leta 1966 je Brian Wilson pod znamko The Beach Boys izdal Pet Sounds in namignil na spremembe v popularni glasbi. Z njim je rockovska glasba postala tudi intimno in duhovno doživetje, in ne več samo brezskrbna plesna zabava. Na vsakem koraku so ga citirali celo Beatli.

programme.title: EPK 2025 Nova Gorica -Gorizia, -od near no one normal- / EPK 2025 Nova Gorica – Gorica, -Od blizu ni nihče normalen-
programme.desc: The large blue sculpture of horses Marko - Marco Cavallo is a symbol of Italian psychiatric reform led by dr. Franz Basaglie, who advocated eliminating imprisoned psychiatric hospitals, human approaches and involving patients in the community. Horse Marko, which was created in the 70s in Trieste as an expression of rebellion against institutionalization, this year went through Slovenia, from Trieste to the Museum of Madness in Trat. He visited special institutions and transferred the messages of their residents to the museum of madness. The journey of the Mark Horse, accompanied by artistic, cultural and educational events, is part of the broader Basaglia project as part of the European Capital of Culture Nova Gorica - Gorica. / Velika modra skulptura Konj Marko – Marco Cavallo je simbol italijanske psihiatrične reforme pod vodstvom dr. Franca Basaglie, ki se je zavzemal za odpravo zaprtih psihiatričnih bolnišnic, humane pristope in vključevanje pacientov v skupnost. Konj Marko, ki je nastal v 70. letih v Trstu kot izraz upora proti institucionalizaciji, se je letos odpravil po Sloveniji, od Trsta do Muzeja norosti na Tratah. Obiskal je posebne zavode in sporočila njihovih stanovalcev prenesel v Muzej norosti. Potovanje Konja Marka, ki so ga spremljale umetniške, kulturne in izobraževalne prireditve, je del širšega Projekta Basaglia v sklopu Evropske prestolnice kulture Nova Gorica - Gorica.

programme.title: To nicer: Old Believers, Mon. / Na lepše: Staroverci, pon.
programme.desc: The team of the show to nicer this time walked along the paths of the old faith, which helps us understand the life and spirituality of our ancestors. They visited the Vogrsko mansion, where the rarely seen objects of Starišci were on display, gathered by the granddaughter of Paul Medvešček, a well -known researcher and writer of folk tradition. The path of the old religion continues in the Doblarec Gorge, the strongest right tributary of the Soča River, where the former shrine was. In Kambrešek, who borders with the adjacent Venice, she spoke about Jožica Strgar about the habits of her ancestors along the wooden hearth in a monumentally protected Lukec House. In the show, the story of the unusual rituals performed in the Triglavac Cave, where Boris Čok, researcher of the old faith, took the team. / Ekipa oddaje Na lepše je tokrat hodila po poteh stare vere, ki nam pomaga razumeti življenje in duhovnost naših prednikov. Obiskali so dvorec Vogrsko, kjer so bili na ogled postavljeni redko videni predmeti starovercev, katere je zbrala vnukinja Pavla Medveščka, znanega raziskovalca in zapisovalca ljudskega izročila. Pot stare vere se nadaljuje v soteski Doblarec, najmočnejšem desnem pritoku reke Soče, kjer je bilo nekdanje svetišče. Na Kambreškem, ki meji s sosednjo Benečijo pa je o navadah svojih prednikov ob lesenem ognjišču v spomeniško zaščiteni Lukčevi hiši, spregovorila Jožica Strgar. V oddaji pa tudi zgodba o nenavadnih ritualih, ki so jih njega dni izvajali v jami Triglavca, kamor je ekipo odpeljal Boris Čok, raziskovalec stare vere.

programme.title: As if it were yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Cliche / Cliche
programme.desc: Justice acts as a guiding star for orientation, but when it comes to giving a definition we immediately get lost. In today's imagination it is a word invoked, abused, always linked to its opposite, injustice, and we can see that immediately. The episode of Cliche dedicated to the word "Justice" and the areas that it shapes in our imagination begins from this provocation. Because "justice is a fluid word that hides deceptions", according to the psychiatrist and psychotherapist Graziano Martignoni, who speaking in the episode among Lorenzo Buccella's guests, recalls how it is a purely human construction that finds confirmation and conflict in the law, which in turn is a human construction that is very distant, for example, from the spontaneous feelings of a child. It is also far from the feelings of the individual, especially when it comes to a gender comparison, between man and woman. This is supported by the journalist and writer Irene Soave, who ranges in her research from the working situation, with the book "The Statute of Workers", to changes in customs, with the book "Etiquette for Marriage Girls", to discover that, in all areas, many feminine clichés are confirmed which unfortunately give shape to a very real gender gap. Gino Cecchettin then speaks, sadly known in the news for the femicide of his daughter Giulia, who believes "a compromise with justice is necessary to avoid suffering all your life", and the Oscar-winning actress Emma Thompson, who underlines the thin line that leads from the sense of personal justice to militant activism, which she is often involved with. The journey into clichés and the sense of justice ends with the intervention of Antonio Di Pietro, politician and former magistrate famous for the Mani Pulite investigation, who often found himself confronted with the limits and contradictions of human justice with respect to the law. Also in the episode is the writer Tommaso Soldini, who rereads the classic of American literature "To Kill a Mockingbird" by Harper Lee, the artist Sir Taki with his work of video-collage created with material from the historical RSI archives, and musical performances by DJ Yeelen. / La giustizia fa da stella polare per orientarsi, ma quando si tratta di darne una definizione ci si perde subito. Nell’immaginario di oggi è una parola invocata, abusata, sempre legata al suo opposto, l’ingiustizia, e quella invece la si vede subito. Da questa provocazione prende il via la puntata di Cliche dedicata alla parola “Giustizia” e agli ambiti che questa disegna nel nostro immaginario. Perche “giustizia è una parola fluida che nasconde inganni”, secondo lo psichiatra e psicoterapeuta Graziano Martignoni, che intervenendo in puntata tra gli ospiti di Lorenzo Buccella, ricorda come sia una costruzione puramente umana che trova riscontro e scontro nella legge, a sua volta costruzione umana lontanissima, ad esempio, dal sentire spontaneo di un bambino. E lontana anche dal sentire del singolo, soprattutto quando si tratta di un confronto di genere, tra uomo e donna. Lo sostiene la giornalista e scrittrice Irene Soave, che spazia nelle sue ricerche dalla situazione lavorativa, con il libro “Lo statuto delle lavoratrici”, ai cambiamenti del costume, con il libro “Galateo per ragazze da marito”, per scoprire che, in tutti gli ambiti, si confermano molti luoghi comuni al femminile che purtroppo danno forma a un realissimo gap di genere.Intervengono poi Gino Cecchettin, tristemente noto alla cronaca per il femminicidio della figlia Giulia, che ritiene necessario “un compromesso con la giustizia per non soffrire tutta la vita”, e l’attrice premio Oscar Emma Thompson, che rimarca il confine sottile che porta dal senso di giustizia personale all’attivismo militante, di cui lei spesso di è occupata. Chiude il viaggio nei luoghi comuni e nel senso di giustizia l’intervento di Antonio Di Pietro, politico ed ex magistrato famoso per l’inchiesta Mani Pulite, che spesso si è trovato a confrontarsi con i limiti e le contraddizioni della giustizia umana rispetto alla legge.Nella puntata anche lo scrittore Tommaso Soldini, che rilegge il classico della letteratura americana “Il Buio oltre la siepe” di Harper Lee, l’artista Sir Taki con la sua opera di video-collage realizzata con materiale degli archivi storici RSI, e gli interventi musicali a cura della DJ Yeelen.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

In his daily life he finds himself dealing with a family made up almost exclusively of women: his wife Vanessa and his three daughters Mandy, Eve and Kristin. / Mike Baxter, direttore marketing di un noto marchio di negozi sportivi, è un uomo allantica e di sani principi. Nella vita quotidiana si trova alle prese con una famiglia composta quasi esclusivamente da donne: la moglie Vanessa e le tre figlie Mandy, Eve e Kristin.

programme.title: I'm coming back to you / Ritorno da te
programme.desc: Abby, a Los Angeles lawyer entirely dedicated to work, agrees to participate in a nature retreat with her best friend Rachel. The intention to indulge in relaxation and forget the daily stress, however, clashes with the meeting of Sean, an old friend of Abby, with whom the woman has no longer had contact since the end of high school. An excursion at sunset will be an opportunity to dispel old resentments and make peace but also to develop a new awareness of oneself and others. / Abby, avvocata di Los Angeles interamente dedita al lavoro, acconsente a partecipare a un ritiro nella natura con la sua migliore amica Rachel. Lintenzione di abbandonarsi al relax e dimenticare lo stress quotidiano però si scontra con lincontro di Sean, un vecchio amico di Abby, con cui la donna non ha più contatti dalla fine delle superiori. Unescursione al tramonto sarà loccasione per dissipare i vecchi rancori e fare pace ma anche per maturare una nuova consapevolezza di se e dellaltro.

programme.title: Psych / Psych
programme.desc: Shawn Spencer has the opportunity of a lifetime: opening a detective agency with his friend Gus. And a psychic, or rather, pretends to be one, in reality just has a great gift for noticing details at all times. / Shawn Spencer ha loccasione della sua vita: aprire unagenzia investigativa con il suo amico Gus. E un sensitivo, o meglio, si finge tale, in realtà ha solo una grande dote nel notare i dettagli in ogni momento.

programme.title: Private Eyes / Private Eyes
programme.desc: Shade and Angie must investigate a strange robbery that occurred in a club where Drag Queens perform. As the case becomes more complicated than expected, the two will have the opportunity to re-examine their relationship, arriving at the same conclusion. Meanwhile, Don becomes a city councilor. / Shade e Angie devono indagare su una strana rapina avvenuta in un locale dove si esibiscono Drag Queen. Mentre il caso diventa più complicato del previsto, i due avranno loccasione di riesaminare il loro rapporto, arrivando alla medesima conclusione. Nel frattempo, Don diventa consigliere comunale.

programme.desc: In the heart of Borneo, every day at dawn a small community of volunteers goes to a rehabilitation center for orphaned or injured orangutans, where they help them develop the fundamental skills to return to living in freedom in the jungle. / Nel cuore del Borneo, ogni giorno allalba una piccola comunità di volontari si reca in un centro di riabilitazione per oranghi orfani o feriti, dove li aiutano a sviluppare le abilità fondamentali per tornare a vivere in libertà nella giungla.

programme.title: The upstairs neighbors / I vicini del piano di sopra
programme.desc: Thomas and Anna have been going through a profound marital crisis for some time. The new neighbors upstairs, on the contrary, seem to experience an overwhelming passion, so much so that they are often noticed for their ardent effusions. Determined to address the topic, Anna invites them for an aperitif, but the evening takes a completely unexpected turn. / Thomas e Anna attraversano da tempo una profonda crisi coniugale. I nuovi vicini del piano di sopra, al contrario, sembrano vivere una passione travolgente, tanto da farsi spesso notare per le loro ardenti effusioni. Decisa ad affrontare l’argomento, Anna li invita per un aperitivo, ma la serata prende una piega del tutto inaspettata.

programme.title: Doctor Godard, the man who wanted to leave everything behind / Docteur Godard, lhomme qui voulait tout quitter
programme.sub-title: Luomo che voleva rifarsi una nuova vita
programme.desc: 1999, Brittany, France. A wonderful September day, the sun is shining and the sea is calm. The case begins with the discovery of a dinghy off the coast, it belongs to a sailing ship chartered in Saint-Malo. In the dinghy are an oilskin pea coat and a checkbook. The sailing ship had been chartered by a doctor with a practice in Caen who then left with his two children without leaving a trace. The authorities search everywhere for the boat and the missing family, in vain. In the van and in the doctor's house the investigators find traces of blood. The blood of Dr. Godard's wife. It is the beginning of a court case that will last over twelve years. The disappearance is shrouded in mystery, various clues are found in the sea in an inexplicable way. Is this a suicide disguised as a shipwreck? / 1999, Bretagna, Francia. Una meravigliosa giornata di settembre, splende il sole e il mare è calmo. Il caso inizia con la scoperta di un gommone al largo della costa, appartiene a un veliero noleggiato a Saint-Malo. Nel gommone ci sono una giacca da marinaio di tela cerata e un libretto degli assegni. Il veliero era stato noleggiato da un medico con studio a Caen che poi è partito con i suoi due bambini senza lasciare traccia. Le autorità cercano ovunque la barca e la famiglia scomparsa, invano. Nel furgone e nellabitazione del dottore gli inquirenti trovano tracce di sangue. Il sangue della moglie del dottor Godard. È linizio di un caso giudiziario che durerà oltre dodici anni. La scomparsa è avvolta nel mistero, vari indizi vengono ritrovati in mare in maniera inspiegabile. Si tratta di un suicidio mascherato da naufragio?

programme.title: Doctor Godard, the man who wanted to leave everything behind / Docteur Godard, lhomme qui voulait tout quitter
programme.sub-title: Luomo che voleva rifarsi una nuova vita
programme.desc: The second episode opens with a turning point in the investigation, the investigators receive an anonymous letter. According to the mysterious informant, Doctor Godard and his two children are alive and on the Isle of Man, in the Irish Sea. The French gendarmes go to the scene and collect the testimonies of various people who confirm the presence of the fugitive. A hotel manager claims to have seen him in the company of a blonde woman. But the track is a dead end. According to Jean-Paul Aubry, of the research section of the Rennes gendarmerie, to find the reason for the escape one must dig into the doctor's life and past. The investigations reveal the complex character of Doctor Godard, a shady man with multiple and surprising facets, a proponent of alternative medicine, passionate about esotericism and very close to a sect that may have helped him stage his disappearance. / Il secondo episodio si apre con una svolta nellinchiesta, gli inquirenti ricevono una lettera anonima. Secondo linformatore misterioso il dottor Godard e i suoi due bambini sono vivi e si trovano sullIsola di Man, nel Mar dIrlanda. I gendarmi francesi vanno sul posto e raccolgono le testimonianze di varie persone che confermano la presenza del fuggitivo. Un direttore dalbergo afferma di averlo visto in compagnia di una donna bionda. Ma la pista è un vicolo cieco. Secondo Jean-Paul Aubry, della sezione ricerche della gendarmeria di Rennes, per trovare il motivo della fuga bisogna scavare nella vita e nel passato del dottore. Le indagini svelano la complessità caratteriale del dottor Godard, un uomo ombroso dalle molteplici e sorprendenti sfaccettature, fautore della medicina alternativa, appassionato di esoterismo e molto vicino a una setta che potrebbe averlo aiutato nel mettere in scena la sua scomparsa.

programme.title: When love blossoms / Quando sboccia lamore
programme.desc: Rory, a young public relations professional arrives at a picturesque BandB for her parents' wedding anniversary. Where she meets the ex who broke her heart with his new girlfriend, in a panic she pretends that the owner of BandB is her boyfriend. / Rory, una giovane professionista delle pubbliche relazioni arriva in un pittoresco BandB per lanniversario di matrimonio dei suoi genitori. Dove incontra lex che le ha spezzato il cuore con la sua nuova ragazza, in preda al panico finge che il proprietario del BandB sia il suo ragazzo.

Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. programme.title: Contrasts / Cuntrasts
programme.sub-title: 104 Hauser fur 104 Familien – Patricia Scarpatetti und ihr neues Dorf
programme.desc: Nino Schurter wants to achieve even more great results in his last year in the mountain bike World Cup. At almost 40 years old, he once again faces the tough professional routine, straining his body, despite knowing that many opponents are even 20 years younger than him and that victories are becoming rarer. Florian Zutt's documentary follows the Graubünden mountain bike legend from the start of the season at the Cape Epic in South Africa, through the World Championships in Valais, up to his last participation in a World Cup race at his home. Once again Nino Schurter gives everything to make his dream of winning in Lenzerheide come true. At the same time, the film allows us to get to know Nino Schurter in his private life, discovering who he is as a person and a father. It's a dive into the environment and family that shaped him. How will the champion be able to detach himself from the life of the professional he has lived for almost 25 years? / Nino Schurter anche nel suo ultimo anno nella Coppa del Mondo di mountain bike vuole raggiungere una volta di più grandi risultati. A quasi 40 anni, affronta ancora una volta la dura routine professionale, sforzando il suo corpo, pur sapendo che molti avversari hanno anche 20 anni meno di lui e che le vittorie diventano più rare.Il documentario di Florian Zutt segue la leggenda grigionese della mountain bike dall’inizio della stagione alla Cape Epic in Sudafrica, passando per i Campionati del Mondo in Vallese, fino alla sua ultima partecipazione a una gara di Coppa del Mondo a casa sua. Ancora una volta Nino Schurter dà tutto per realizzare il sogno di vincere a Lenzerheide.Allo stesso tempo, il film permette di conoscere Nino Schurter nella sua vita privata, scoprendo il suo essere persona e padre. È un tuffo nell’ambiente e nella famiglia che lo hanno plasmato.Come potrà il campione staccarsi dalla vita del professionista che ha vissuto per quasi 25 anni?

programme.title: The Sisters / Les Sisters
programme.desc: It's decided: Marine must find a fake lover and break up with him for real. How do you look like you're in love? / C’est decide : Marine doit trouver un namoureux pour de faux et casser avec lui pour de vrai. Mais Maman n’a pas l’air convaincue par le couple que Marine forme avec Titouan… Comment on fait pour avoir l’air namoureux ?

programme.title: The Sisters / Les Sisters

programme.title: The Sisters / Les Sisters
programme.desc: Marine loses her things so much that Mom refuses to buy her the new Super Piou-Piou t-shirt. programme.title: The 3 Musketeers / Les 3 Mousquetaires

programme.title: Truquees videos, ado in danger / Videos truquees, ado en danger
programme.desc: On the Bridgeway High School cheerleading team, the coach, Deb, tends to favor her daughter, Beth, causing the jealousy of the other mothers. During an audition for a scholarship at the prestigious Rossmore Carmel University, deepfake videos of Beth are broadcast on the internet, distorting the fresh and kind remarks she makes on her social networks to the attention of her fans. Beth appears as a depraved and cruel girl. These videos sow doubt in those around Beth. / Au sein de lequipe de cheerleaders du lycee de Bridgeway, la coach, Deb, a tendance à favoriser sa fille, Beth, provoquant la jalousie des autres mères. A loccasion dune audition pour une bourse dans la prestigieuse unversite de Rossmore Carmel, des videos deepfake de Beth sont diffusees sur internet, deformant les propos frais et gentils quelle tient sur ses reseaux sociaux à lattention de ses fans. Beth apparaît comme une fille depravee et cruelle. Ces videos sèment le doute dans lentourage de Beth.

programme.title: Modern Family / Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil and Claire feel snubbed by their children: Alex gave them a false university entry date to prevent them from dramatizing his departure. / Phil et Claire se sentent snobes par leurs enfants : Alex leur a donne une fausse date dentree à luniversite pour eviter quils dramatisent son depart.

programme.title: Murdoch's plugs / Les enquetes de Murdoch
programme.desc: The Temperance League is campaigning in the city of Toronto to enforce prohibition. Arthur Slauson, municipal councilor for the Junction district, is found dead, poisoned by the consumption of adulterated alcohol. He was the only one to defend the sale of alcohol at the Junction… / La Ligue pour la temperance est en campagne dans la ville de Toronto pour que soit appliquee la prohibition. Arthur Slauson, conseiller municipal du quartier de la Junction, est retrouve mort, empoisonne par labsorption dun alcool frelate. Il etait le seul à defendre la vente dalcool à la Junction…

programme.title: Rizzoli and Isles / Rizzoli and Isles
programme.desc: A post office employee is found dead in his car. Everything suggests that it was a suicide. Jane and Korsak go to her home and come across CJ, a postal service inspection agent, who was to collaborate with the victim on one of his investigations. Jane then asks CJ to help them with theirs. They discover that the victim was involved in drug trafficking and was in fact killed. For her part, Maura indulges in new activities to develop new neuronal pathways in her brain... / Un employe dun bureau de poste est retrouve mort dans sa voiture. Tout laisse à croire quil sagit dun suicide. Jane et Korsak se rendent à son domicile et tombent sur CJ, un agent de linspection des services postaux, qui devait collaborer avec la victime sur lune de ses enquetes. Jane demande alors à CJ de les aider sur la leur. Ils decouvrent que la victime etait impliquee dans un trafic de medicaments et quelle a en fait ete tuee. De son côte, Maura sadonne à de nouvelles activites pour developper de nouvelles voies neuronales dans son cerveau...

programme.title: Rizzoli and Isles / Rizzoli and Isles
programme.desc: Jane investigates the apparently accidental death of a wealthy and influential lawyer. The latter would have fallen down her stairs. But upon discovering the lifeless body of the lawyer, the police suspect something other than bad luck. The murderer, intelligent and determined to get away with his perfect crime, begins to play cat and mouse with the team, drawn unwillingly in this direction. Maura unexpectedly grows closer to Hope as she recovers from surgery following a minor procedure. Frankie and Nina's relationship comes to light... / Jane enquete sur la mort apparemment accidentelle dune riche et influente avocate. Cette dernière aurait chute dans ses escaliers. Mais en decouvrant le corps sans vie de la juriste, les policiers soupçonnent autre chose quune mauvaise fortune. Le meurtrier, intelligent et determine à sen tirer grâce à son crime parfait, commence à jouer au chat et à la souris avec lequipe, entraînee malgre elle dans cette direction. Maura se rapproche de Hope, contre toute attente, alors quelle recupère de sa chirurgie après une intervention mineure. La relation de Frankie et Nina eclate au grand jour...

programme.title: Here it all begins / Ici tout commence
programme.desc: Filmed in the Camargue, “Here it all begins” is the story of a dynasty of great chefs. Viewers will immerse themselves in the life of a school that will train the future big names in gastronomy. Ready for a new plot? / Tourne en Camargue, "Ici tout commence" est lhistoire d’une dynastie de grands chefs. Les telespectateurs plongeront dans la vie d’une ecole qui formera les futurs grands noms de la gastronomie. Pret(s) pour une nouvelle intrigue ?

programme.title: This is my question / Cest ma question
programme.desc: A general culture game reflects the diversity and passions of the French-speaking people. It is in fact the public, represented on the set by a wall of images, which will question the duo candidates in the running. Everyone can ask a question related to their profession, their region or their centers of interest. Faced with a multitude of portraits, who to choose? A game presented by Sebastien Pasche / Un jeu de culture generale reflète la diversite et les passions des Romands. Cest en effet le public, represente sur le plateau par un mur dimages, qui interrogera les candidats duo en lice. Chacun peut poser une question en relation avec son metier, sa region ou ses centres dinterets. Face à une multitude de portraits, qui choisir ? Un jeu presente par Sebastien pasche
